definition: The space enclosed by the walls of the pharynx.

label: tympanum
definition: The major portion of the middle ear (auris media), consisting of a narrow air-filled cavity in the temporal bone that contains the auditory ossicles. It communicates with the mastoid air cells and the mastoid antrum via the aditus and with the nasopharynx via the auditory tube. The middle ear and the tympanic cavity were formerly regarded as being synonymous.

label: middle ear
definition: The cavity in the temporal bone comprising the cavitas tympani, adnexa mastoidea, and tuba auditiva.

label: outer ear
definition: The portion of the auditory organ comprising the auricle and the external acoustic meatus.

label: multiple myeloma cell
definition: A malignant proliferation of plasma cells in bone marrow causing numerous tumors and characterized by the presence of abnormal proteins in the blood.

label: MOPC-104E cell
definition: Murine plasmacytoma cell line.

label: MOPC-173 cell
definition: Murine plasmacytoma cell line; also described as mouse myeloma tumor.

label: BE(2)-M17 cell
definition: Human caucasian neuroblastoma cell line. The cell line BE(2)-M17 was isolated from SK-N-BE(2) by limiting dilution.

label: perisympathetic organ
definition: In the perisympathetic organs of insects there is a neurohemal structure acting as neurohormonal release sites.

label: neurohemal organ
definition: A system of neurons that has the specialized function to produce and secrete hormones, and that constitutes, in whole or in part, an endocrine organ or system.

label: submucosa
definition: The layer of areolar tissue situated beneath the mucous membrane. The layer of loose connective tissue between the lamina muscularis mucosae and the tunica muscularis in most parts of the digestive, respiratory, urinary, and genital tracts.

label: tela submucosa bronchiorum
definition: The layer of tissue underlying the tunica mucosa of the bronchi.

label: tela submucosa esophagi
definition: The layer of tissue underlying the tunica mucosa of the esophagus.

label: tela submucosa gastris
definition: The tissue underlying the tunica mucosa of the stomach.

label: tela submucosa intestini crassi
definition: The layer of tissue underlying the tunica mucosa of the large intestine.

label: tela submucosa intestini tenuis
definition: The submucous layer of the wall of the small intestine.

label: tela submucosa pharyngis
definition: The tissue underlying the tunica mucosa of the pharynx.

label: tela submucosa recti
definition: The submucous layer of the wall of the rectum.

label: tela submucosa tracheae
definition: The tissue underlying the tunica mucosa of the trachea.

label: tela submucosa tubae uterinae
definition: The submucous layer of the wall of the uterine tube.

label: tela submucosa vesicae urinariae
definition: The submucous layer of the wall of the urinary bladder.

label: spikelet
definition: A small or secondary spike, specifically one of the small few-flowered bracted spikes that make up the compound inflorescence of a grass or sedge.

label: pyloric cecum
definition: The pyloric ceca (or digestive glands) and the cardiac stomach produce digestive enzymes in starfishes. Digested material is absorbed through the pyloric ceca for transport to the rest of the body. Each pyloric cecum extends the length of each arm.

label: pyloric stomach
definition: The pyloric ceca (or digestive glands) and the cardiac stomach produce digestive enzymes in starfishes.

label: cardiac stomach
definition: In starfishes the cardiac stomach is connected to a pyloric stomach which is located above it. Food can be brought into the stomach through the mouth or, in many species, the cardiac stomach can be extended out through the mouth to digest food outside the body. Suspension-feeding starfish use their tube feet to pass food to the mouth.

label: primitive endoderm
definition: The primitive endoderm is the lower layer of the blastocyst that gives rise to fetal membranes.

label: ampulla
definition: The constant contraction of ampulla (to extend and retract the tube feet) helps to move a starfish. The ampullae are teeth like structures surrounding the radial canal.

label: water vascular system
definition: The water vascular system is a hydraulic system used by Echinoderms for locomotion, food and waste transportation, and respiration. Composed of water filled tube feet and ampulla, Echinoderms move by contracting the muscles around the ampulla forcing water in the tube feet, which causes the foot to extend propelling the animal forward.

label: U-373MG cell
definition: Human caucasian glioblastoma/astrocytoma cell line; established from a 61-years-old caucasian male.

label: U-138MG cell
definition: Human glioblastoma cell line; established from a 47 years old human male.

label: TX3868 cell
definition: Multiform glioblastoma cell line.

label: SK-MEL-1 cell
definition: Human melanoma; established from the lymph node metastasis (thoracic duct) of a 29-year-old Caucasian man with primary melanoma in 1966.

label: SK-MEL cell
definition: Human metastatic melanoma cell line.

label: SK-MEL-28 cell
definition: Human skin melanoma cell line; established from a 51-years old human male.

label: SK-MEL-3 cell
definition: Human melanoma established from the lymph node metastasis of a malignant melanoma from a 42-year-old Caucasian woman.

label: SK-MEL-30 cell
definition: Human melanoma derived from tumor tissue (subcutis metastasis) of a 67-year-old Caucasian man with malignant melanoma in 1975.

label: SK-MEL-5 cell
definition: Human caucasian skin melanoma cell line; established from a 24 year old Caucasian female. Derived from: axillary node.

label: INS-1 cell
definition: Pancreatic beta -cell line of rat origin.

label: NB-4 cell
definition: Human acute promyelocytic leukemia cell line; established from the bone marrow of a 23-year-old woman with acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL = AML FAB M3) in second relapse in 1989.

label: MiaPaCa-2 cell
definition: Human pancreatic cancer cell line.

label: MiaPaCa cell
definition: Human pancreatic carcinoma cell line.

label: HS-683 cell
definition: Human brain glioma cell line. Hs 683 was isolated from explant cultures of a glioma taken from the left temporal lobe of a 76 year old male Caucasian.

label: RPMI-7931 cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: BCS-TC2 cell
definition: Human colon adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: BRIN-BD11 cell
definition: Insulin secreting beta cell line.

label: CEM-VCR R cell
definition: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia cell line, resistant to vincristine.

label: acute lymphoblastic leukemia cell line
definition: Lymphocytic leukemia cell line that is marked by an abnormal increase in the number of lymphoblasts, that is characterized by rapid onset and progression of symptoms which include fever, anemia, pallor, fatigue, appetite loss, bleeding, thrombocytopenia, granulocytopenia, bone and joint pain, and enlargement of the lymph nodes, liver, and spleen, and that occurs chiefly during childhood.

label: CAL-62 cell
definition: Human thyroid anaplastic carcinoma cell line, established from the thyroid gland (right lobe) of a 70-year-old woman with thyroid anaplastic carcinoma in 1988; described as being tumorigenic in heterotransplanted nude mice.

label: type II intestinal metaplasia disease specific cell type
definition: Metaplasia is the change in the type of adult cells in a tissue to another form of adult cells that are not normal for that tissue.

label: gas bladder
definition: A thin membranous, sometimes alveolated sac in the dorsal portion of the abdominal cavity. Contains a varying mixture of gases, not identical to the composition of air. May be one, two or three chambered. May be connected to the gut by a tube, the ductus pneumaticus (then called physostomous) or unconnected (then called physoclistous). May function as one or more of:- hydrostatic organ, sound producing organ, sound receptor, respiratory organ. Found in Actinopterygii. Often lacking in bottom fishes.

label: gill raker
definition: One of a series of variously shaped bony or cartilaginous projections on the inner side of the branchial arch. The rakers have epithelial denticles and both their gross and fine structure serves to retain food particles in the mouth. The gill raker count normally includes all rakers, even the rudiments, and is made on the front half of the first arch. Upper and lower gill raker counts may be presented as the upper and the lower (including the central raker), e.g. 9 + 17; or as upper rakers, central raker, and lower rakers, e.g. 9 + 1 + 16. The most anterior and posterior rakers are often small and delicate, easily torn or lost if the arch is removed. Plankton feeders have numerous, crowded, elongate and fine rakers while predators have few, separated, short and stubby rakers.

label: gill filament
definition: The thread-like, soft, red respiratory and excretory structure projecting outward from the gill arch.

label: gill raker sieve
definition: The set of gill rakers on the gill arches acting as a filter or sieve.

label: gill arch
definition: The endochondral skeletal support of the gill which bears the gill filaments and the gill rakers. Consists of pharyngobranchials, epibranchials, ceratobranchials and hypobranchials. Usually 4 in teleosts, can be as many as 16 in some Cyclostomata.

label: pharyngobranchial
definition: The deep, endochondral bone at the top of the gill arch. May bear the upper pharyngeal and a dentigerous plate. May occur on arches 1, 2, 3, 4. Also called super-pharyngeals or superior pharyngeals. Suprapharyngobranchials are never associated with teeth while infrapharyngobranchials may be associated with dermal plates bearing teeth.

label: epibranchial
definition: A deep cartilage bone on the upper part of the gill arch below the uppermost element, the pharyngobranchial. May occur on arches 1, 2, 3, 4 and be covered with toothed pads.

label: ceratobranchial
definition: A long, deep, endochondral bone in the middle portion of the gill arches between the epibranchials and the hypobranchials. There are usually 5 pairs of ceratobranchials, absent in some Anguillidae, Polypterus and Calamoichthys. The fifth pair of ceratobranchialas are modified in Cypriniformes and Siluriformes into a strong, tooth-bearing bone called the inferior pharyngobranchial bone.

label: hypobranchial
definition: One of a series of deep, paired endochondral bones on the lower part of the gill arch between the ceratobranchials and the basibranchials. May occur on arches 1, 2, 3, 4 and bear dentigerous plates. Salmonidae have only 3 pairs. In Chondrichthyes they are the most ventral paired cartilages.

label: endochondral bone
definition: Refers to skeletal elements which are formed in cartilage and which later ossify. Also called replacement bone because it gradually replaces the pre-existing cartilage.

label: huelle cell
definition: A cell having a thickened cell wall and a small lumen. Hulle cells are associated with species of Aspergillus. They are associated with the cleistothecia of all ascogenous species of the Aspergillus nidulans group, abundantly occurring around it.

label: cleistothecium
definition: The fruiting body (ascocarp) produced by certain ascomycetes, in which there is no pore for the escape of ascospores, the spores being released by rupture or decay of the body.

label: apothecium
definition: An open or expanded fruiting body seen in lichens and actinomycetous fungi, having asci contained on its exposed surface.

label: ascocarp
definition: The fruiting body of an ascomycetous fungus, including the asci and ascospores.

label: ascus
definition: The sporangium or spore case of certain lichens and fungi, consisting of a single terminal cell.

label: gymnothecium
definition: A type of fruiting body (ascocarp) composed of a loose network of mycelia through which ascospores filter and are released at maturity; its reproductive organs are in the form of naked asci. Seen in fungi of the family Gymnoascaceae.

label: perithecium
definition: The flask-shaped fruiting body of certain molds and ascomycetous fungi having a pore for the escape of spores.

label: basidium
definition: The clublike organ of the fungal class Basidiomycotina which, following karyogamy and meiosis, bears the basidiospore.

label: basidiospore
definition: A type of sexual spore that forms on a basidium.

label: mushroom
definition: The fruiting body (basidiocarp) of any of a variety of basidiomycetous fleshy fungi of the order Agaricales, especially one that is edible. Poisonous species are popularly called toadstools.

label: juvenile
definition: Physiologically immature or undeveloped stage.

label: anterior commissure
definition: A bundle of myelinated nerve fibers passing transversely through the lamina terminalis and connecting symmetrical parts of the two cerebral hemispheres; it consists of a smaller anterior part (pars anterior commissurae anterioris) and a larger posterior part (pars posterior commissurae anterioris).

label: LOX cell
definition: Human amelanotic malignant melanoma cell line.

label: ABFTL-6 cell
definition: Mouse mast cell line.

label: tubercle
definition: The adult male dorsal surface of Schistosoma is covered in small bosses called tubercles that provide purchase against the blood vessel wall when the worm is crawling up the mesenteric veins carrying the female in its ventral groove. Each tubercle has a thin, 2-3 micron, covering of the syncytial tegument. Enclosed entirely within the tegument cytoplasm of the tubercle are a series of spines, made of actin, which assist in gripping the blood vessel. The tegument is normally closely apposed to the underlying circular muscle layer, and separated from it only by an extracellular matrix of collagen fibres. The tubercle is the exception, where the tegument is lifted up by numerous extensions of parenchymal cells. The parenchymal cell bodies lie below the muscle layers and send out narrow extensions of cytoplasm which insinuate between the muscles to form the packing for the tubercle.

label: parenchymal cell
definition: Any cell that is a functional element of an organ, such as a hepatocyte.

label: LLC-RK1 cell
definition: New Zealand white rabbit kidney cell line.

label: Pro-5 cell
definition: Cricetulus griseus (Chinese hamster) ovary cell line from a female. This line is a derivative of the original CHO cell line and is the parental line for several glycosylation mutants.

label: PR cell
definition: Osteosarcoma cell line.

label: HMEpC cell
definition: Human Mammary Epithelial Cells (HMEpC) are derived from normal adult mammary glands.

label: 184A1N4 cell
definition: The 184A1N4 and 184B5 cell lines are nontumorigenic cell lines derived from primary cultures of HMECs that were immortalized with benzo(a)pyrene.

label: 184-B5 cell
definition: Human mammary gland, breast epithelium cell line; established from normal mammary tissue obtained from a normal reduction mammoplasty. Cells derived from the tissue were exposed to benzo-alpha-pyrene, and a transformed line was established.

label: HEK-293T cell
definition: A highly transformed human renal epithelial line expressing two viral oncogenes, adenovirus E1a and SV40 large T antigen.

label: 95D cell
definition: High metastatic human giant-cell lung carcinoma cell line.

label: 95C cell
definition: Low metastatic human giant-cell lung carcinoma cell line.

label: fibre tract
definition: A bundle of nerve fibers (axons) having a common origin, termination, and function.

label: SCC12b cell
definition: Squamous cell carcinoma cell line.

label: SCC-13 cell
definition: Squamous cell carcinoma cell line.

label: NHK cell
definition: Normal human keratinocyte cell line.

label: A10 cell
definition: Vascular smooth muscle cell line derived from rat thoracic aorta.

label: M22 cell
definition: Gamma-Glutamyl transpeptidase-positive, tumorigenic rat liver oval cell line, tumorigenic counterpart of OC/CDE22 cell line.

label: OC/CDE22 cell
definition: Gamma-Glutamyl transpeptidase (GGT)-negative, non-tumorigenic rat liver oval cell line.

label: HCT-15 cell
definition: Human colon adenocarcinoma cell line; established from Dukes' type C colorectal adenocarcinoma.

label: lung squamous cell carcinoma cell line
palatine uvula
definition: The small cone-shaped process suspended in the mouth from the middle of the posterior border of the soft palate.

label: large cell lung cancer cell line
small cell lung cancer cell line
K6H6/B5 cell
definition: Mouse/human hybrid myeloma cell line. Heterohybridoma cell line.

label: NCI-H596 cell
definition: Human lung adenosquamous carcinoma cell line; derived in 1983 from a tumor mass in the chest wall of a patient with adenosquamous carcinoma of the lung.

label: SiHa cell
definition: HPV16 cervical cancer cell line.

label: oral squamous cell carcinoma cell line
cervical squamous cell carcinoma cell line
LN-319 cell
definition: Anaplastic astrocytoma cell line.

label: LN-428 cell
definition: Human glioblastoma cell line.

label: culture supernatant
definition: The clear fluid above a sediment or precipitate of a cell culture.

label: chalazal cell
definition: A cell of the region of an ovule that is opposite the micropyle, where the integuments and nucellus are joined.

label: adrenocortical carcinoma cell
definition: A malignant adrenal cortical tumor that can cause endocrine disorders such as Cushing's syndrome or adrenogenital syndrome.

label: 15PC3 cell
definition: Prostate cancer cell line.

label: HLE-B3 cell
definition: Human lens epithelial cell line.

label: bract
definition: A small modified leaf in a flower cluster.

label: BW/T200- cell
definition: Mouse T-lymphoma cell line.

label: cheek pouch
definition: A pocketlike fold of skin in the cheeks of various animals, such as squirrels, gophers, and monkeys, that functions as a means of carrying food.

label: culture fluid
definition: The liquid culture medium, obtained after filtration of the cell culture.

label: Calu-6 cell
definition: Human anaplastic carcinoma cell line, probably from lung. Established from a 62-years-old caucasian female.

label: ovarian cumulus cell
definition: The somatic granulosa cells surrounding the oocyte are termed cumulus cells.

label: ectomycorrhiza
definition: Ectomycorrhizae are organs where the fungus hyphae are mostly in the outer tissues of the non-woody root.

label: endomycorrhiza
definition: Endomycorrhizae are organs where the fungus hyphae are mainly throughout the non-wood root.

label: endectomycorrhiza
definition: Endectomycorrhiza are organs that are not distinctly one type or the other (see endo- and ectomycorrhiza).

label: exodermis
definition: A layer of the outer living cortical cells of plants that takes over the functions of the epidermis in roots lacking secondary thickening.

label: eyelid
definition: Either of the movable folds of skin and muscle that can be closed over the eyeball.

label: hypanthium
definition: The ringlike, cup-shaped, or tubular structure of a flower on which the sepals, petals, and stamens are borne, as in the flowers of the rose or cherry.

label: flower stalk
definition: A slender stalk supporting or connecting another plant part, such as a leaf or flower.

label: globus pallidus
definition: The smaller and more medial part of the lentiform nucleus of the brain, separated from the putamen by the lateral medullary lamina. In official anatomic nomenclature, it is divided by the medial medullary lamina into two parts, lateral and medial, both of which have extensive connections with the corpus striatum, thalamus, and mesencephalon. The paleostriatum is the phylogenetically older part of the corpus striatum represented by the globus pallidus.

label: globus pallidus lateralis
definition: Globus pallidus lateral segment: the larger, lateral part of the globus pallidus, separated from the putamen by the lateral medullary lamina and from the smaller, medial part of the globus pallidus by the medial medullary lamina.

label: globus pallidus medialis
definition: Globus pallidus medial segment: the smaller, medial part of the globus pallidus, separated from the larger, lateral part by the medial medullary lamina.

label: cervical canal
definition: In the anatomy of the female reproductive system, the canal of the cervix is the spindle-shaped, flattened canal of the cervix, the neck of the uterus. It communicates with the uterine cavity via the internal orifice of the uterus, and with the vagina via the external orifice.

label: nucleus lentiformis
definition: The part of the corpus striatum somewhat resembling a biconvex lens, divided into an external, larger, lateral part (putamen) and an internal, smaller, lighter colored medial part (globus pallidus), which is in turn subdivided into a smaller, medial, and a larger, lateral part by the medial medullary lamina.

label: lamina medullaris medialis corporis striati
definition: A layer of white substance that divides the medial portion of the lentiform nucleus (globus pallidus) into a larger, lateral, and a smaller, medial part.

label: subthalamic nucleus
definition: A biconvex mass of gray matter on the medial side of the junction of the internal capsule and the crus cerebri; its chief connections are with the globus pallidus.

label: GOTO cell
definition: Human glioblastoma cell line.

label: vas efferens
definition: Any of a number of small ducts that carry semen from the testis to the epididymis.

label: HCT-8 cell
definition: Human colonic cancer cell line.

label: heterotroph
definition: A heterotrophic organism.

label: heterotrophic cell
definition: Not self-sustaining cell; said of a type of nutrition in which organisms derive energy from the oxidation of organic compounds either by consumption or absorption of other organisms.

label: autotroph
definition: An autotrophic organism.

label: autotrophic cell
definition: Self-sustaining cell; said of a type of nutrition in which organisms are capable of synthesizing organic molecules as nutritive substances.

label: HS-68 cell
definition: Hs68 is one of a series of human foreskin fibroblast lines developed at the Naval Biosciences Laboratory (NBL) in Oakland, CA. The material was obtained from an apparently normal Caucasian newborn male in February, 1969.

label: plant pedicel
definition: 1. A small stalk or stalklike part bearing a single flower in an inflorescence. 2. A support for a fern sporangium or moss capsule.

label: ventriculus
definition: 1. A hollow digestive organ, especially the stomach of certain insects or the gizzard of a bird. 2. The digestive cavity in the body of a sponge.

label: microplasmodium
definition: The aggregation stage of Physarum polycephalum.

label: honey sac
definition: A distension of the esophagus of a bee in which honey is elaborated.

label: MLE-12 cell
definition: Mouse lung cancer cell line. This line was established in 1992 by Kathryn A. Wikenheiser from pulmonary tumors in a mouse transgenic for the SV40 large T antigen under the control of the promoter region of the human surfactant protein C gene. The cells express the mRNA for large T antigen. Lung surfactant proteins B and C were detected. The cells secrete phospholipids in response to phorbol esters and ATP but not in response to forskolin.

label: JEG-3 cell
definition: Human choriocarcinoma cell line; established from a human gestational choriocarcinoma which was taken at autopsy from a cerebral metastasis; serial sister cell line of cell line BEWO.

label: MCF-7/2a cell
definition: Mimosine-resistant cell line.

label: MCS-2 cell
definition: The MCS-2 cell line is established by introduction of the human steroid-sulfatase (STS) gene into estrogen-dependent human breast cancer MCF-7 cells.

label: merozoite
definition: A protozoan cell that arises from the schizogony of a parent sporozoan and may enter either the asexual or sexual phase of the life cycle.

label: ileocecum
definition: The ileum and cecum considered as one organ.

label: BHT-101 cell
definition: Human thyroid carcinoma cell line; established from the lymph node metastasis of a 63-year-old woman with anaplastic papillary thyroid carcinoma.

label: lateral hypodermal chord
definition: Dorsal, ventral or lateral longitudinal thickenings of the hypodermis, generally internal.

label: immobilized cell
definition: Cells are immobilized by embedding them for example in Calcium-alginate.

label: melanotroph
definition: A pituitary cell type that elaborates melanocyte-stimulating hormone and beta-endorphins. Melanotrophs are abundant in animals that have a pars intermedia adenohypophyseos; humans have very few.

label: J-774 cell
definition: Mouse macrophage cell line.

label: lignifying cell
definition: A lignifying cell deposits lignin in its cell wall. Lignifying cells are localized in different plant tissues.

label: YZI-1S cell
definition: Photomixotrophically cultured tobacco cells (Nicotiana tabacum L. cv. Samsun NN).

label: Pt-K2 cell
definition: Potorous tridactylis (potoroo) normal kidney cell line.

label: NCI-H157 cell
definition: Human large cell lung cancer cell line.

label: MIN-6 cell
definition: The murine insulinoma MIN6 cell line derived from in vivo immortalized insulin-secreting pancreatic beta cells.

label: POGS-5 cell
definition: Immortalized cell line of primary granulosa cells, isolated from 25-day-old immature rats and transfected with SV40 DNA alone.

label: POGRS-1 cell
definition: Immortalized cell line of primary granulosa cells, isolated from 25-day-old immature rats and transfected with SV40 DNA and Ha-ras oncogene.

label: GLHR-15 cell
definition: Immortalized cell line of primary granulosa cells, isolated from 25-day-old immature rats and transfected with SV40 DNA, Ha-ras, and LH/CG receptor expression plasmid.

label: GFSHR-17 cell
definition: Immortalized cell line of primary granulosa cells, isolated from 25-day-old immature rats and transfected with SV40 DNA, Ha-as, and FSH receptor expression plasmid.

label: SP2/0-AG14 cell
definition: SP2/0-AG14 is a hybrid between BALB/c spleen cells and the myeloma cell line P3X63AG8.

label: flagellum
definition: Long, slender, threadlike, whiplike extension of certain cells or unicellular organisms used mainly for movements (others for signal transduction). In bacteria, the flagella are helical filaments made up of the protein, flagellin, and rotate like screws. In eukaryotes, such as in cells of animals, plants and protists, they are made up of microtubules surrounded by the plasma membrane and enable the cells to move in a whip-like fashion. Some flagella are not used for movement but in sensation and signal transduction by various cell types, e.g. rod photoreceptor cells of the eye, olfactory receptor neurons of the nose, kinocilium in cochlea of the ear.

label: SAKRTLS 12.1 cell
definition: Mouse T-lymphoma cell line.

label: solid substrate culture
definition: Cell culture on a solid material.

label: podocyte
definition: A modified epithelial cell of the capsular epithelium of the renal glomerulus, having a small perikaryon and a number of primary and secondary footlike radiating processes (pedicels) that interdigitate with those of other podocytes and embrace the basal lamina of glomerular capillaries.

label: capsular epithelium
definition: The outer, or parietal, layer of the renal glomerular capsule, composed of simple squamous epithelium, and separated from the inner, or visceral, layer by the capsular space.

label: renal glomerular capsule
definition: The double-walled globular dilatation that forms the beginning of a uriniferous tubule of the kidney and surrounds the glomerulus; it consists of an inner, or visceral, layer (capsular epithelium) and an outer, or parietal, layer (glomerular epithelium).

label: inferior olivary complex
definition: A folded band of gray matter that encloses a white core (hilum nuclei olivaris inferioris) and that produces the elevation called the oliva on the medulla oblongata. It is a nuclear complex that receives heavy projections from the spinal cord, mesencephalon, and cerebral cortex and projects fibers via the contralateral inferior cerebellar peduncle, mostly to the neocerebellum, with a few going to the vermis.

label: oliva
definition: A part of each pyramid of the medulla oblongata, between the ventrolateral and dorsolateral sulci; it is formed by an irregular mass of gray substance (nucleus olivaris caudalis) located just beneath its surface and is linked by fiber systems to the pons and cerebellum.

label: hilum nuclei olivaris inferioris
definition: The white core of the inferior olivary nucleus of the medulla oblongata, most prominent medially.

label: mucinous cystadenoma cell
definition: A cell of a multilocular tumor produced by the epithelial cells of the ovary and having mucin-filled cavities; the great majority of these tumors are benign.

label: inferior mesenteric artery
definition: Origin: Abdominal aorta, branches, left colic, sigmoid, and superior rectal arteries. Distribution: descending colon, rectum.

label: superior mesenteric artery
definition: Origin: abdominal aorta; branches, inferior pancreaticoduodenal, jejunal, ileal, ileocolic, right colic, and middle colic arteries; distribution: small intestine, proximal half of colon.

label: protoscolex
definition: The scolex of a larval stage of the hydatid tapeworm. Morphologically it resembles the adult scolex.

label: scolex
definition: The anterior organ of a tapeworm used for attachment to host tissues.

label: ARO cell
definition: Human anaplastic thyroid cancer cell line.

label: yeast form
definition: 1. Any of various unicellular fungi of the genus Saccharomyces, especially S. cerevisiae, reproducing by budding and from ascospores and capable of fermenting carbohydrates. 2. Any of various similar fungi.

label: myoepithelium
definition: A specialized type of epithelium that has contractile qualities.

label: myoepithelial cell
definition: Modified smooth muscle cells, contractile in nature, believed to be of ectodermal origin, located around the secretory units of certain glands (salivary, mammary, sweat, and lacrimal glands) between the gland cells and basement membrane, having long dendritic interweaving cytoplasmic processes, and containing myofilaments. It is assumed that contraction of these cells functions to help express secretion from the gland.

label: mammary myoepithelial cell
definition: The human breast epithelium is a branching ductal system composed of an inner layer of polarized luminal epithelial cells and an outer layer of myoepithelial cells that terminate in distally located terminal duct lobular units (TDLUs).

label: mature cell
definition: Having reached full natural growth or development: a mature cell.

label: immature cell
definition: Not fully grown or developed.

label: satellite cell
definition: 1. Glial cells that cluster about a neuron. 2. Free nuclei that accumulate around cells in certain diseases. 3. Elongated cells that are closely associated with a muscle fiber; they either are flattened against the fiber or occupy shallow depressions in its surface.

label: supporting cell
definition: Cells that serve to provide support and protection and perhaps contribute to the nutrition of principal or other cells of certain organs; such cells are found in the labyrinth of the inner ear, organ of Corti, olfactory epithelium, taste buds, and seminiferous tubules (Sertoli's cells).

label: stellate cell
definition: Any cell having a star-shaped appearance produced by numerous processes that extend in different directions, such as the Kupffer cells in the liver, astrocytes, and granule cells in the granular layers of the cerebral and cerebellar cortices.

label: slow muscle
definition: The darker-colored muscle tissue of some mammals, composed of slow twitch muscle fibers.

label: fast muscle
definition: The paler-colored muscle tissue of some mammals, composed of fast twitch muscle fibers.

label: skeletal muscle fiber
definition: Skeletal muscle fibers are cylindrical multinucleate cells containing contracting myofibrils, across which run transverse striations, enclosed in a sarcolemma.

label: cardiac muscle fiber
definition: Cardiac muscle fibers contain one or sometimes two nuclei and myofibrils and are separated from one another by an intercalated disk; although striated, cardiac muscle fibers branch to form an interlacing network.

label: intermediate muscle fiber
definition: Muscle fibers having characteristics intermediate between red and white muscle fibers.

label: eccrine sweat gland
definition: An ordinary, or simple, sweat gland; they are of the merocrine type, unbranched, coiled, tubular glands that are distributed over almost all of the body surface, and promote cooling by evaporation of their secretion.

label: merocrine gland
definition: One in which the secretory cells maintain their integrity throughout the secretory cycle.

label: holocrine gland
definition: A gland whose discharged secretion contains entire secreting cells.

label: breast apocrine carcinoma cell
definition: A rare breast malignancy with a ductal or acinar growth pattern and apocrine secretions.

label: stem cortex
definition: The outermost rows of cells in a cross section of the stem.

label: ventral nerve cord
definition: The pair of closely united ventral longitudinal nerves with their segmental ganglia that is characteristic of many elongate invertebrates (as earthworms).

label: dorsal nerve cord
definition: The dorsal tubular cord of nervous tissue above the notochord of a chordate that comprises or develops into the central nervous system.

label: lamina propria
definition: A highly vascular layer of connective tissue under the basement membrane lining a layer of epithelium.

label: PLHC-1 cell
definition: Poeciliopsis lucida hepatoma cell line, a fish cell line.

label: Mono-Mac-6 cell
definition: Human acute monocytic leukemia cell line; established from the peripheral blood of a 64-year-old man with relapsed acute monocytic leukemia (AML FAB M5) in 1985 following myeloid metaplasia. Sister cell line of MONO-MAC-1.

label: ARPE-19 cell
definition: ARPE-19 is a spontaneously arising retinal pigment epithelia (RPE) cell line derived in 1986 by Amy Aotaki-Keen from the normal eyes of a 19-year-old male who died from head trauma in a motor vehicle accident.

label: plant collar
definition: The neck or line of junction between the root of a plant and its stem.

label: leaf collar
definition: A thin band of intercalary meristematic tissue at the junction of the leaf blade (lamina) and the leaf sheath found in grasses.

label: bradyzoite
definition: A small, comma-shaped form of Toxoplasma gondii, found in clusters enclosed by an irregular wall (pseudocyst) in the tissues, chiefly muscles and the brain, in chronic (latent) toxoplasmosis; considered to be the slow-growing form.

label: tarsal bone
definition: Any of the seven bones of the tarsus. The seven bones constituting the articulation between the foot and the leg-the talus, calcaneus, and navicular, in the proximal row; and the cuboid and the lateral, intermediate, and medial cuneiform bones, in the distal row.

label: electrocyte
definition: A modified striated muscle cell that does not contract, but produces electric signals; the component of the electric organ in some fish.

label: hindlimb
definition: Either of two extremities of four-footed non-primate land animals. It usually consists of a femur, tibia and fibula, tarsals, metatarsals, and toes.

label: fibula
definition: The outer and smaller of the two bones of the leg, which articulates proximally with the tibia and distally is joined to the tibia in a syndesmosis.

label: metatarsal bone
definition: Any of the five bones extending from the tarsus to the phalanges of the toes, being numbered in the same sequence from the most medial to the most lateral.

label: toe
definition: 1. Any of the five digits of the foot. 2. The anterior part of a horse's hoof.

label: hallux
definition: The first digit of the foot.

label: digitus secundus pedis
definition: The second digit of the foot.

label: digitus tertius pedis
definition: The third digit of the foot.

label: digitus quartis pedis
definition: The fourth digit of the foot.

label: digitum minimus pedis
definition: The fifth, and smallest, digit of the foot.

label: talus
definition: The highest of the tarsal bones and the one that articulates with the tibia and fibula to form the ankle joint.

label: calcaneal bone
definition: The irregular quadrangular bone at the back of the tarsus.

label: navicular bone
definition: The ovoid-shaped tarsal bone that is situated between the talus and the three cuneiform bones.

label: cuboid bone
definition: The cuboid bone.

label: lateral cuneiform bone
definition: The most lateral of the three wedge-shaped tarsal bones located medial to the cuboid and between the navicular and the first three metatarsal bones.

label: intermediate cuneiform bone
definition: The intermediate and smallest of the three wedge-shaped tarsal bones located medial to the cuboid and between the navicular and the first three metatarsal bones; called also o. cuneiforme secundum.

label: medial cuneiform bone
definition: The medial and largest of the three wedge-shaped tarsal bones located medial to the cuboid and between the navicular and the first three metatarsal bones.

label: osteochondroma cell
definition: A benign tumor consisting of projecting adult bone capped by cartilage projecting from the lateral contours of endochondral bones.

label: pancreatic duct
definition: The main excretory duct of the pancreas, which usually unites with the common bile duct before entering the duodenum at the major duodenal papilla.

label: pancreatic ductal carcinoma cell
definition: Carcinoma that arises from the pancreatic ducts. It accounts for the majority of cancers derived from the pancreas.

label: gastric pit
definition: Any of the numerous pits in the gastric mucosa marking the openings of the gastric glands.

label: chondroblastoma cell
definition: Any cell of a usually benign tumor derived from immature cartilage cells, occurring primarily in the epiphyses of adolescents; it is characterized by fine, matrix-like calcifications arranged hexagonally, often resembling chicken wire, around closely packed cells.

label: extravillous trophoblast
definition: The outermost layer of trophoblast, produced by cytotrophoblast where there is direct contact with maternal decidua rather than blood. The EVT cells travel into the decidua, reacting with NK cells and invading maternal blood vessels feeding the placenta, softening the walls and replacing the lining with fetal tissue, a process called conversion.

label: cytotrophoblastic cell
definition: Polygonal, mononucleate cells resembling the cells of the cytotrophoblast, having prominent nucleoli and clear, eosinophilic or cyanophilous cytoplasm; one of the two cell types that compose a choriocarcinoma.

label: 3Y1-B clone 1 cell
definition: Rat Fischer cell line; established from a female rat embryo /whole fetus. Mother clone of 3Y1 series, fibroblast-like.

label: HR-3Y1 cell
definition: 3Y1 cell line, transformed with v-Ha-ras oncogene.

label: colleterial gland
definition: A gland in female insects that secretes a cement by which the eggs are glued together or attached to an external object.

label: macroplasmodium
definition: The vegetative stage (macroplasmodium) of Physarum polycephalum is a large, single cell containing multiple dipoid nuclei that divide precisely at the same time.

label: neuroepithelioma cell
definition: A rare type of neuroepithelial tumor, usually found in the brain or retina, composed of primitive neuroepithelial cells lining the tubular spaces.

label: glioblastoma multiforme cell
definition: A type of tumor that forms from glial (supportive) tissue in the brain. It is highly malignant, grows very quickly, and has cells that look quite different from normal glial cells. Early symptoms may include sleepiness, headache, and vomiting.

label: anaplastic astrocytoma cell
definition: Moderately malignant astrocytomas, including most anaplastic astrocytomas and sometimes including the less malignant of the glioblastoma multiforme group.

label: bronchiole
definition: A minute thin-walled branch of a bronchus.

label: duodenal gland
definition: Any of the compound racemose glands in the submucous layer of the duodenum that secrete alkaline mucus and a potent proteolytic enzyme.

label: SR-3Y1 cell
definition: 3Y1 cell line transformed by Rous sarcoma virus.

label: pilocytic astrocytoma cell
definition: An astrocytoma resembling the fibrillary type but with its fibrils arranged in parallel rows; its grade of malignancy is low. The most common kind is the cerebellar juvenile pilocytic astrocytoma. In adults the pilocytic type is usually found in the cerebrum.

label: juvenile pilocytic astrocytoma cell
definition: A pilocytic astrocytoma found in the cerebellum in children, one of the most common juvenile brain tumors; it grows slowly and has a low grade of malignancy.

label: MKN-28 cell
definition: Well differentiated human gastric adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: MKN-7 cell
definition: Well differentiated human gastric adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: MKN-74 cell
definition: Well differentiated human gastric adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: MKN-1 cell
definition: Human gastric adenosquamous carcinoma cell line.

label: GLC-4 cell
definition: Human small cell lung cancer (SCLC) cell line.

label: GLC-4/ADR cell
definition: Subline of human small cell lung cancer (SCLC) cell line (GLC4) with in vitro acquired resistance to adriamycin (GLC4/ADR).

label: GLC-4/MITO cell
definition: Subline of human small cell lung cancer (SCLC) cell line (GLC4) with in vitro acquired resistance to mitoxantrone (GLC4/MITO).

label: GLC-4/CDDP cell
definition: A subline of human small cell lung cancer (SCLC) cell line (GLC4) with in vitro acquired resistance to cisplatin (GLC4/CDDP).

label: U-1285 cell
definition: Small cell carcinoma of the lung (SCC). The U-1285 line was derived from the classical small cell type of SCC.

label: U-1568 cell
definition: Small cell carcinoma of the lung (SCC). The U-1568 originated from a larger cell variant of SCC.

label: U-1285dox cell
definition: Doxorubicin-resistant cell line, U-1285dox, derived from human small cell carcinoma of the lung.

label: SGC-7901 cell
definition: Human gastric cancer cell line.

label: N-27 cell
definition: N27 is an immortalized dopaminergic neuronal cell line isolated from fetal rat mesencephalic cultures.

label: DC-3F cell
definition: Chinese hamster lung fibroblast cell line.

label: DC-3F/ADX cell
definition: The MDR cell line DC-3F/ADX was originally selected from spontaneously transformed Chinese hamster lung fibroblasts DC-3F.

label: NIH-3T3-G185 cell
definition: The NIH-3T3-G185 cell line, which contains the gene product of human MDR1, was licensed from the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

label: prostate gland epithelium
definition: Normal prostatic epithelium is composed of basal and luminal cells.

label: PNT-2 cell
definition: Human normal prostate epithelium cell line immortalized with SV40.

label: OLN-93 cell
definition: The permanent oligodendrocyte cell line OLN-93, derived from spontaneously transformed cells in primary rat brain glia cultures.

label: feather rachis
definition: The central shaft of the feather to which the vanes are attached.

label: oviduct epithelium
definition: There are two types of cells within the simple columnar epithelium of the Fallopian tube. Ciliated cells predominate throughout the tube, but are most numerous in the infundibulum and ampulla. Interspersed between the ciliated cells are peg cells, which contain apical granules and produce the tubular fluid. This fluid contains nutrients for spermatozoa, oocytes and zygotes.

label: OS-RC-2 cell
definition: Human renal cell carcinoma (RCC) cell line.

label: YMB-1 cell
definition: Human breast cancer cell line; established from a 55 year-old human female.

label: EoL-1 cell
definition: Human eosinophilic leukaemia cell line.

label: eosinophilic leukemia cell line
definition: A form of granulocytic leukemia cell line characterized by abnormal numbers of or a predomination of eosinophilic granulocytes in the tissues and blood.

label: spermary
definition: An organ or a gland in which male gametes are formed, especially in invertebrate animals.

label: NRK-52E cell
definition: Rat kidney epithelial-like cells. Cell line was cloned from a mixed culture of normal rat kidney cells as was NRK-49F the two cell lines were described to be distinct in growth properties and in transforming abilities; NRK-52E is supposed to be much more stable.

label: NRK-49F cell
definition: Rat kidney fibroblast cell line. Cell line was cloned from a mixed culture of normal rat kidney cells.

label: giant cell carcinoma cell
definition: A poorly differentiated, highly malignant, epithelial neoplasm containing numerous very large, multinucleated tumor cells, such as occurs in the lungs.

label: PG cell
definition: Metastatic human lung giant cell carcinoma (PG) cell line.

label: PG-BE1 cell
definition: Cloned PG cell subline.

label: PG-CL3 cell
definition: Cloned PG cell subline.

label: PG-LH7 cell
definition: Cloned PG cell subline.

label: NCI-H929 cell
definition: Human multiple myeloma cell line; established from the pleural effusion of a 62-year-old white woman with myeloma (IgAkappa) at relapse.

label: helper T-lymphocyte
definition: A T-cell that participates in an immune response by recognizing a foreign antigen and secreting lymphokines to activate T cell and B cell proliferation, that usually carries CD4 molecular markers on its cell surface, and that is reduced to 20 percent or less of normal numbers in AIDS.

label: NCI-H292 cell
definition: Mucoepidermoid human lung carcinoma cell line; established from a 32 years old black female; Morphology: epithelial.

label: SK-BR-3 cell
definition: Human breast adenocarcinoma cell line; established from a caucasian female 43 years old. Morphology: epithelial-like.

label: monocytic leukemia cell
definition: A cell of leukemia characterized by the proliferation of monocytes and monoblasts in the blood.

label: eosinophilic leukemia cell
definition: A form of granulocytic leukemia cell line characterized by abnormal numbers of or a predomination of eosinophilic granulocytes in the tissues and blood.

label: mesothelium
definition: The layer of flat cells, derived from the mesoderm, that line the coelom or body cavity of the embryo. In the adult, it forms the simple squamous epithelium that covers all true serous membranes (peritoneum, pericardium, pleura).

label: mesothelioma cell
definition: A cell from a tumor derived from mesothelial tissue (peritoneum, pleura, pericardium); both benign and malignant varieties exist. Malignant varieties are often the result of excessive exposure to asbestos.

label: MSTO-211H cell
definition: Human mesothelioma cell line; established from the pleural effusion of a 62-year-old Caucasian man with mesothelioma (malignant biphasic) who did not have any prior therapy.

label: CHOP cell
definition: Chinese hamster ovary cells expressing polyoma LT antigen.

label: KYSE-150 cell
definition: Human esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cell line; established from the poorly differentiated esophageal squamous cell carcinoma resected from upper (cervical) esophagus of a 49-year-old Japanese woman after receiving radiotherapy.

label: esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cell line
HA22T/VGH cell
definition: The HA22T/VGH cell line was established from a surgical specimen of hepatocellular carcinoma obtained from a 56-year-old Chinese male.

label: Lec15.1 CHO cell
definition: Lec15.1 Chinese hamster ovary cells are deficient in DPM synthase activity.

label: HuO-3N1 cell
definition: Human osteosarcoma cell line. Osteoblastic cell line.

label: prespore
definition: Cell in the rear portion of the migrating slug (grex) of a cellular slime mould, which will later differentiate into spore cells. Can be recognised as having different proteins by immunocytochemical methods.

label: dorsal raphe nucleus
definition: A large raphe nucleus extending from the anterior part of the pons through the mesencephalon; its neurons are serotoninergic.

label: myenteric plexus
definition: That part of the enteric plexus within the tunica muscularis.

label: enteric plexus
definition: A plexus of autonomic nerve fibers within the wall of the digestive tube, and made up of the submucosal, myenteric, and subserosal plexuses; it contains visceral afferent fibers, sympathetic postganglionic fibers, parasympathetic preganglionic and postganglionic fibers, and parasympathetic postganglionic cell bodies.

label: Dogiel's corpuscle
definition: A type of lamellated corpuscle found in the genital mucous membranes and in the skin around the nipples.

label: CX-1 cell
definition: Human colon adenocarcinoma cell line; established from the tumor tissue of a 44-year-old woman with well-differentiated colon adenocarcinoma in 1984; cell line is a subclone of cell line HT-29.

label: pericyte
definition: One of the peculiar elongated cells with the power of contraction, found wrapped about the outside of precapillary arterioles, postcapillary venules, and capillaries.

label: tetrad of microspores
definition: A group of four cells, as of spores or pollen grains, formed by division of one mother cell.

label: tetrad of pollen
definition: A group of four cells, as of spores or pollen grains, formed by division of one mother cell.

label: basal forebrain
definition: The basal forebrain is a term for a group of structures that lie near the bottom of the front of the brain, including the nucleus basalis, diagonal band, medial septum and substantia innominata. These structures are important in the production of a brain chemical called acetylcholine, which is then distributed widely throughout the brain.

label: diagonal band
definition: A band of nerve fibers that forms the caudal zone of the anterior perforated substance where it adjoins the optic tract, which is continuous caudolaterally with the periamygdaloid area and rostromedially passes above the optic chiasm to blend with the paraterminal gyrus.

label: medial septum
definition: A nucleus in the septal area, coextensive with the diagonal band of Broca; it has afferent and cholinergic efferent connections with a variety of forebrain and brain stem areas including the hippocampus, the lateral hypothalamus, the tegmentum, and the amygdaloid bodies.

label: substantia innominata
definition: Nerve tissue immediately inferior to the anterior perforated substance, and anterior to the globus pallidus and ansa lenticularis.

label: basal telencephalon
definition: The region of the telencephalon lying deep in the cerebral hemispheres.

label: anterior hypothalamic nucleus
definition: A nucleus of nerve cells in the anterior hypothalamic region.

label: dorsal hypothalamic nucleus
definition: A nerve cell nucleus situated in the dorsal portion of the intermediate hypothalamic region.

label: medial dorsal nucleus of thalamus
definition: The largest of the medial nuclei of the thalamus, having a rostral magnocellular part and a caudolateral parvocellular part, both of which make extensive intrathalamic connections with most of the other thalamic nuclei.

label: median nucleus of thalamus
definition: Small groups of nonspecific nerve cells scattered in the periventricular gray substance, separating the medial part of the thalamus from the ependyma of the third ventricle, and partly forming the interthalamic adhesion; included in the group are the anterior and posterior paraventricular nuclei, nucleus parataenialis, nucleus commissuralis rhomboidalis, and nucleus reuniens.

label: anterior paraventricular nucleus
definition: The anterior of the two nuclei paraventriculares thalami.

label: posterior paraventricular nucleus
definition: The posterior of the two nuclei paraventriculares thalami.

label: nucleus parataenialis
definition: One of the median nuclei of the thalamus, situated ventral and medial to the stria medullaris.

label: rhomboid nucleus
definition: One of the median nuclei of the thalamus, bordering the third ventricle and ventral to the central medial nucleus.

label: nucleus reuniens
definition: One of the median nuclei of the thalamus; it is situated near the interthalamic adhesion, bordering the third ventricle, ventral to the central medial nucleus.

label: paraventricular nucleus
definition: The nucleus paraventricularis anterior thalami and nuclues paraventricularis posterior thalami, two of the nuclei mediani thalami; they are situated on the dorsomedial wall of the thalamus, juxtaposed to the third ventricle.

label: posterior hypothalamic nucleus
definition: A nucleus of nerve cells in the posterior hypothalamic region, above the lateral and medial nuclei of the mammillary body; it has major brain stem connections via periventricular fibers and the dorsal longitudinal fasciculus.

label: posterior nuclear complex of thalamus
definition: Groups of nerve cells anterior to the pulvinar, forming an ill-defined complex that receives afferents from the spinothalamic tract and superior and inferior colliculi.

label: ventral lateral complex of thalamus
definition: Nuclei ventrolaterally located within the ventral thalamic nuclei, subdivided into anterior and posterior nuclei.

label: ventrobasal complex of thalamus
definition: The nuclei that form the posterior ventral part of the ventral nuclei of the thalamus, comprising a posterolateral nucleus and a posteromedial nucleus.

label: nucleus ventralis posterolateralis thalamus
definition: The more lateral of the two posterior ventral nuclei of the thalamus; it is the terminus of the spinothalamic tract and the medial lemniscus and it projects to the postcentral gyrus.

label: nucleus ventralis posteromedialis thalamus
definition: The more medial of the two posterior ventral nuclei of the thalamus; it is the secondary trigeminal tract and sends axons to the somesthetic area of the postcentral gyrus for the face.

label: ventral nucleus of thalamus
definition: A large group of nuclei lying between the internal medullary lamina and the internal capsule; it includes ventral anterior, ventral intermediate, ventral lateral, ventral medial, ventrobasal and other nuclei, which relay impulses to various specific areas of the cerebral cortex.

label: ventral anterior nucleus of thalamus
definition: A nucleus anteriorly located within the ventral nuclei of the thalamus, posterior to the reticular nucleus, anterior to the ventral lateral nucleus, and lateral and medial to the internal and external medullary laminae, respectively; it is subdivided into magnocellular and principal divisions.

label: ventral intermediate nucleus of thalamus
definition: A nucleus medially located within the ventral nuclei of the thalamus.

label: ventral medial complex of thalamus
definition: A group of nuclei located in the medial portion of the ventral thalamic nuclei.

label: ventromedial hypothalamic nucleus
definition: A group of nerve cell bodies found in the ventral portion of the intermediate hypothalamic region; it is involved in diverse functions, for example, food intake and sexual behavior.

label: infundibular nucleus
definition: A nucleus of nerve cells in the posterior hypothalamic region, extending into the median eminence and almost entirely surrounding the base of the infundibulum.

label: dorsomedial nucleus of intermediate hypothalamus
definition: A group of nerve cell bodies found in the dorsal part of the intermediate hypothalamic region.

label: endopeduncular nucleus
definition: A small nucleus in the internal capsule of the hypothalamus adjacent to the medial edge of the globus pallidus.

label: paraventricular nucleus of hypothalamus
definition: A sharply defined band of cells in the wall of the third ventricle in the anterior hypothalamic region; many of its cells are neurosecretory in function, secreting oxytocin, which is carried to the neurohypophysis (posterior pituitary) by the fibers of the paraventriculohypophysial tract.

label: posterior periventricular nucleus
definition: A nucleus of nerve cells in the intermediate hypothalamic area, lying in the posterior part of the third ventricle.

label: plume
definition: Organisms as Riftia pachyptila end with a deep red fan-like structure (plume) which extends into the water and which absorbs H2S and O2 for the bacteria, and also absorbs CO2 for use as synthetic raw material. An animal structure having a main shaft bearing many hairs or filamentous parts; especially: a full bushy tail.

label: lateral tuberal nucleus
definition: Nerve cell nuclei situated ventrally in the intermediate hypothalamic region, mainly in the lateral hypothalamic area.

label: gonadotrophic cell
definition: A basophil of the adenohypophysis whose granules secrete follicle-stimulating hormone and luteinizing hormone. Called also delta basophil, delta cell, and gonadotrope or gonadotropic cell.

label: interventricular septum
definition: The partition that separates the left ventricle from the right ventricle, consisting of a muscular and a membranous part.

label: columnar cell
definition: An elongated epithelial cell.

label: atrial appendage
definition: The ear-shaped appendage of either atrium of the heart.

label: lupulin gland
definition: Gland on unfertilised female inflorescences that produces lupulin.

label: metacyclic form
definition: The parasite (Leishmania or Trypanosoma) differentiates into its infective, but non-replicative, metacyclic form.

label: vestimentum
definition: The vestimentum is a muscle that the tubeworm uses to position itself in the tube. It is sequestered within the Riftia tube.

label: CH12.LX cell
definition: The CH12.LX B cell line derived from the murine CH12 B cell lymphoma.

label: mesangium
definition: The thin membrane that helps support the capillary loops in a renal glomerulus.

label: cerebral gyrus
definition: One of the convolutions of the surface of the cerebral hemispheres caused by infolding of the cortex.

label: dentate gyrus
definition: A serrated strip of gray matter under the medial border of the hippocampus and in its depths; it is an archaeocortex which develops along the edge of the hippocampal fissure and which consists of molecular, granular, and polymorphic layers.

label: fasciolar gyrus
definition: A posterior and upward extension of the dentate gyrus, forming a transitional area between the dentate gyrus and the indusium griseum.

label: arachnoid barrier layer
definition: The arachnoid barrier layer is a part of the arachnoid meningeal layer. It is formed by tight junctions between the endothelial cells of cerebral capillaries in the arachnoid mater.

label: companion cell
definition: A specialized parenchyma cell, located in the phloem of flowering plants and closely associated in development and function with a sieve-tube element.

label: arachnoid trabecula
definition: Delicate fibrous threads connecting the inner surface of the arachnoid to the pia mater.

label: trabecula
definition: In anatomical nomenclature, a supporting or anchoring strand of connective tissue, such as one extending from a capsule into the substance of the enclosed organ.

label: kinetoplastid
definition: Pertaining or relating to protozoa of the order Kinetoplastida.

label: protozoan form
definition: Any individual of the Protozoa.

label: anaplastic large cell lymphoma cell
definition: An aggressive (rapidly progressing) type of non-Hodgkins lymphoma that is usually of the T-cell type. The cancer cells express a marker called CD30 or Ki-1 on the surface, and may appear in the lymph nodes, skin, bones, soft tissues, lungs, or liver.

label: enteric nervous system
definition: Two ganglionated neural plexuses in the gut wall which form one of the three major divisions of the autonomic nervous system. The enteric nervous system innervates the gastrointestinal tract, the pancreas, and the gallbladder. It contains sensory neurons, interneurons, and motor neurons. Thus the circuitry can autonomously sense the tension and the chemical environment in the gut and regulate blood vessel tone, motility, secretions, and fluid transport. The system is itself governed by the central nervous system and receives both parasympathetic and sympathetic innervation.

label: autonomic nervous system
definition: The enteric, parasympathetic, and sympathetic nervous systems taken together. Generally speaking, the autonomic nervous system regulates the internal environment during both peaceful activity and physical or emotional stress. Autonomic activity is controlled and integrated by the central nervous system, especially the hypothalamus and the solitary nucleus, which receive information relayed from VISCERAL AFFERENTS; these and related central and sensory structures are sometimes (but not here) considered to be part of the autonomic nervous system itself.

label: myenteron
definition: The muscular coat of the intestine.

label: corticotropic cell
definition: A small, irregularly stellate, acidophilic cell of the adenohypophysis, having small, sparsely distributed secretory granules and secreting corticotropin and beta-endorphin, which are cleaved from a large prohormone called pro-opiomelanocortin.

label: myelomonocytic leukemia cell
definition: One of the more common types of acute myelogenous leukemia, characterized by both malignant monocytes and myeloblasts; it usually affects middle aged to older adults.

label: pinnule
definition: Any of the ultimate leaflets of a bipinnately compound leaf.

label: leaflet
definition: One of the segments of a compound leaf or a small leaf or leaflike part.

label: Ewing's sarcoma cell
definition: A malignant primary bone tumour that arises most commonly in the first three decades of life.

label: CN1.4 cell
definition: Immortalized embryonic mouse neuronal brain cortex cell line.

label: odontoclast
definition: A large multinuclear cell associated with the absorption and removal of bone. It is cytomorphologically the same as an osteoclast and is involved in cementum resorption.

label: FL-18 cell
definition: Cell line established from the pleural effusion of a patient with follicular small cleaved cell lymphoma.

label: FL-218 cell
definition: Cell line established from effusion cells of two Japanese patients manifesting the transformed histology of follicular lymphoma.

label: FL-318 cell
definition: Cell line established from effusion cells of two Japanese patients manifesting the transformed histology of follicular lymphoma.

label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cell
definition: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is a common type of non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) accounting for about 2 in 5 of all cases. It is a cancer of the B-lymphocytes. Diffuse B-cell lymphoma can occur at any time between adolescence and old age. It is slightly more common in men than in women.

label: HBL-1 cell
definition: An EBV-negative B-cell lymphoma cell line designated as HBL-1 was established from the pleural effusion of a patient with malignant lymphoma, diffuse, large cell.

label: HBL-2 cell
definition: Human diffuse large B cell lymphoma cell line.

label: HEK-293A cell
definition: The QBI-HEK 293A cell line is an immortalized line of primary human embryonic kidney cells transformed by sheared human Ad5 DNA. QBI-HEK 293A cell line is a superior sub-clone of HEK 293 cells and strongly adheres to plastic dishes.

label: cementum
definition: The bonelike rigid connective tissue covering the root of a tooth from the cementoenamel junction to the apex and lining the apex of the root canal, also assisting in tooth support by serving as attachment structures for the periodontal ligament.

label: HBL-4 cell
definition: Human Burkitt's lymphoma cell line(HBL-4 was established from a patient with small noncleaved cell lymphoma (Burkitt's type). The HBL-4 cell line is Epstein-Barr virus (EBV)-negative.

label: HBL-5 cell
definition: Human Burkitt's lymphoma cell lines HBL-5 was established from a patient with small noncleaved cell lymphoma (Burkitt's type). The HBL-5 cell line is Epstein-Barr virus (EBV)-positive.

label: HBL-7 cell
definition: Human Burkitt's lymphoma cell line, negative for Epstein-Barr virus genome.

label: HBL-8 cell
definition: Human Burkitt's lymphoma cell line, negative for Epstein-Barr virus genome.

label: HBL-9 cell
definition: Burkitt lymphoma cell line.

label: HBL-10 cell
definition: Burkitt lymphoma cell line.

label: Kobayashi cell
definition: Burkitt lymphoma cell line.

label: HBL-11 cell
definition: Myeloma cell line.

label: HBL-3 cell
definition: Precursor B acute lymphoblastic leukemia cell line.

label: Morris hepatoma 7800C1 cell
definition: A Wistar rat cell line.

label: feather vane
definition: The flattened part of the feather that is attached on either side of the rachis. Each feather has two vanes.

label: BNL CL.2 cell
definition: Mus musculus BALB/c liver cell line; established from an embryo.

label: LLC-PK-1-GR101 cell
definition: LLC-PK1 renal tubule cell line expressing the Rattus norvegicus glucocorticoid receptor GR.

label: femoral muscle
definition: Origin: anterior and lateral surfaces of femur; insertion: patella, common tendon of quadriceps femoris; innervation: femoral; action, extends leg.

label: alveolar wall
definition: The alveolar walls contain capillaries and a very small interstitial space. In some alveolar walls there are pores between alveoli. There are two major alveolar cell types in the alveolar wall: 1. Flat Type I cells forming the structure of a alveolar wall. 2. Type II cells which secrete surfactant which lowers the surface tension and divide to produce Type I cells.

label: MCF-12A cell
definition: Human mammary epithelial cell line.

label: MCF-12F cell
definition: Nontumorigenic human mammary epithelial cell line.

label: KBM-5 cell
definition: Leukemic cell line derived from a patient in the blastic phase of chronic myelogenous leukemia.

label: KE-37 cell
definition: Human T cell leukemia cell line; established from a 27-year-old man with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) in 1979.

label: BT-549 cell
definition: Human breast ductal carcinoma cell line. The BT-549 line was isolated in 1978 by W.G. Coutinho and E.Y. Lasfargues. Source tissue consisted of a papillary, invasive ductal tumor which had metastasized to 3 of 7 regional lymph nodes.

label: A-2780 cell
definition: Human ovarian carcinoma cell line.

label: CH-1 cell
definition: Human ovarian carcinoma cell line.

label: ACH-2 cell
definition: Chronically infected T-cell line. Human monocytic and T-lymphoid cell line, persistently infected with HIV-1.

label: NCI-H1299 cell
definition: Homo sapiens (human) lung carcinoma cell line, non-small cell lung cancer; derived from metastatic site: lymph node.

label: non-small cell lung cancer cell line
K-562adr cell
definition: Multidrug resistant K-562 cell line.

label: HOSE cell
definition: Human ovarian surface epithelial cell line.

label: HOSE-A cell
definition: Human ovarian surface epithelial (HOSE) cells as a model for ovarian carcinogenesis. Two cultures from two different patients were established, HOSE-A and HOSE-B.

label: HOSE-B cell
definition: Human ovarian surface epithelial (HOSE) cells as a model for ovarian carcinogenesis. Two cultures from two different patients were established, HOSE-A and HOSE-B.

label: INER-37 cell
definition: Human non-small-cell lung cancer cell line.

label: INER-51 cell
definition: INER-51 is a NSCLC cell line established from pleural effusion of patient diagnosed with primary lung cancer without previous chemotherapy treatment.

label: OVCA-2 cell
definition: Human ovarian cancer cell line.

label: OVCA-4 cell
definition: Human ovarian cancer cell line.

label: A-1847 cell
definition: Human ovarian cancer cell line.

label: OVCA-420 cell
definition: Human epithelial ovarian cancer cell line.

label: OVCA-429 cell
definition: Human epithelial ovarian cancer cell line.

label: OVCA-432 cell
definition: Human epithelial ovarian cancer cell line.

label: OVCA-433 cell
definition: Human epithelial ovarian cancer cell line.

label: INER-51/PSC-1 cell
definition: Clone of lung cancer cell line INER-51, non-expressing P-glycoprotein.

label: Colo-201 cell
definition: Human colonic adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: Co-403 cell
definition: Immortalized human coronary artery smooth muscle cell line.

label: coronary artery smooth muscle cell line
Caco-2/TC7 cell
definition: Caco-2/TC7 cell line was established from the parental human enterocyte-like Caco-2 cell line.

label: MEF cell
definition: Mouse embryonic fibroblast cell line.

label: TERA-2 cell
definition: Human embryonal carcinoma (teratocarcinoma). NTERA-2 was cloned from cell line TERA-2 which was derived from a metastatic teratocarcinoma of a 22-year-old Caucasian male.

label: NT2-N cell
definition: Human neuronal (NT2N) cells derive from an NT2 human teratocarcinoma cell line.

label: IGROV-1 cell
definition: Human ovary carcinoma cell line.

label: UMR-106 cell
definition: The UMR-106 cell line is a clonal derivative of a transplantable rat osteosarcoma that had been induced by injection of radiophosphorous (32P).

label: UMR-108 cell
definition: The UMR-108 cell line is a clonal derivative of a transplantable rat osteosarcoma that had been induced by injection of radiophosphorous (32P).

label: feather barbs
definition: The numerous branches off the rachis that form the vanes.

label: IEC-CF7 cell
definition: Rat intestine-derived IEC-6 cells stably expressing cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR).

label: MEG-01 cell
definition: Human chronic myeloid leukemia in megakaryocytic blast crisis established from the bone marrow of a 55-year-old man with chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) in megakaryocytic blast crisis in 1983.

label: HFL-1 cell
definition: Human lung fibroblast cell line; established from a caucasian fetus.

label: YMB-1-E cell
definition: Human breast cancer cell line; established from a 55 year-old female.

label: WRL-68 cell
definition: Hela cells containing human papilloma viral (HPV) DNA sequences.

label: WE-480 cell
definition: Colorectal adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: G-401 cell
definition: Human caucasian kidney cell line. G-401 was deposited as a cell line derived from a Wilms tumor. Due to a change in the classification of such tumors, the cell line was examined by Garvin et al and found to be more appropriately classified as derived from a rhabdoid tumor of the kidney.

label: NCI-H295 cell
definition: Pluripotent adrenocortical carcinoma cell line.

label: NCI-H295R cell
definition: NCI-H295R was adapted from the NCI-H295 pluripotent adrenocortical carcinoma cell line established by A.F. Gazdar and associates from a carcinoma of the adrenal cortex.

label: H-7721 cell
definition: Human hepatocarcinoma cell line.

label: HEY cell
definition: The HEY human ovarian carcinoma cell line was derived from a human ovarian cancer xenograft (HX-62) originally grown from a peritoneal deposit of a patient with moderately differentiated papillary cystadenocarcinoma of the ovary.

label: HL-60/Vinc cell
definition: Multidrug resistant subline of HL-60.

label: DC-3F/S16 cell
definition: Subline of DC-3F resistant to the olovacine derivative S16020-2, named DC-3F/S16.

label: DC-3F/9-OH-E cell
definition: A DC-3F subline resistant to 9-hydroxy-ellipticine.

label: DDT1-MF-2 cell
definition: Syrian golden hamster (Mesocricetus auratus) ductus deferens smooth muscle cell line established from a leiomyosarcoma.

label: NUGC-2 cell
definition: Human gastric adenocarcinoma cell line established from a 56-year-old female.

label: NUGC-3 cell
definition: Human gastric adenocarcinoma cell line established from a 72-year-old male.

label: RBA cell
definition: Rattus norvegicus (rat) mammary gland adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: RBA-2 cell
definition: Rat brain-derived type-2 astrocyte cell line.

label: RAW/LR5 cell
definition: Cell line derived from the murine monocyte/macrophage RAW264.7 cell line.

label: RTH-149 cell
definition: Rainbow trout, Oncorhynchus mykiss, hepatoma cell line.

label: 11-9-1-4 cell
definition: 11-9-1-4 cell line was obtained from the Meharry Tissue Procurement Facility, Meharry Medical College, Nashville, TN. It originated from a human breast epithelial cell line BT-549 at ATCC and transfected with galectin-3, a beta-galactoside binding protein (a cell adhesion molecule).

label: TC-71 cell
definition: Human Ewing's sarcoma cell line; established from the tumor of a 22-year-old man with metastatic Ewing's sarcoma that arose in the humerus; cell line was derived in 1981 from a biopsy of recurrent tumor at the primary site.

label: TE-671 cell
definition: Human rhabdomyosarcoma cell line. In the original publication and in the ATCC catalogue this cell line is described as medulloblastoma; recent studies and the characterization carried out at the DSMZ indicated that TE-671 are muscle cells, most likely identical to the rhabdomyosarcoma cell line RD (also known as TE32 or 130T).

label: glial cell
definition: As glia they build the delicate network of branched cells and fibers that supports the tissue of the central nervous system.

label: SK-LMS-1 cell
definition: Human vulva leiomyosarcoma cell line; established from a 43-years old caucasian female.

label: vomeronasal organ
definition: A specialized part of the olfactory system located anteriorly in the nasal cavity within the nasal septum. Chemosensitive cells of the vomeronasal organ project via the vomeronasal nerve to the accessory olfactory bulb. The primary function of this organ appears to be in sensing pheromones which regulate reproductive and other social behaviors. While the structure has been thought absent in higher primate adults, data now suggests it may be present in adult humans.

label: astroglial cell
definition: Neuroglia tissue made up of astrocytes.

label: pseudopodium
definition: A temporary cytoplasmic extrusion by means of which an ameba or other ameboid organism or cell moves about or engulfs food.

label: axopodium
definition: A long and slender, semipermanent type of locomotor pseudopodium that has a central axial filament composed of a bundle of microtubules.

label: filopodium
definition: A slender filamentous pseudopodium with a pointed end, branched or unbranched, consisting mostly of ectoplasm.

label: lobopodium
definition: A wide, blunt pseudopodium composed of both ectoplasm and endoplasm.

label: reticulopodium
definition: A filamentous pseudopodium with interconnected branches.

label: fascia dentata
definition: The fascia dentata is the earliest stage of the hippocampal circuit. The fascia dentata and the hilus together make up the dentate gyrus.

label: turion
definition: A thick fleshy young shoot or sucker, such as an emerging stem of asparagus.

label: thyroid nodule
definition: Pathological nodule in the thyroid gland, often filled with colloid; some are indicative of adenoma or carcinoma.

label: ejaculatory duct epithelium
definition: The ejaculatory duct epithelium is composed of cuboidal to columnar cells between or through which project the terminal parts of the ducts of the unicellular prostate glands.

label: posterior adductor muscle
definition: Two dorsal muscles, called adductors, extend transversely between the valves, one at the anterior end and the other at the posterior end. The posterior adductor muscle is posterior to the kidney.

label: anterior adductor muscle
definition: Two dorsal muscles, called adductors, extend transversely between the valves, one at the anterior end and the other at the posterior end.

label: spinal muscle
definition: The medial division of the erector spinae.

label: spinal muscle of head
definition: Origin: spines of upper thoracic and lower cervical vertebrae; insertion: occipital bone; innervation: spinal nerves; action, extends head.

label: spinal muscle of neck
definition: Origin: spinous processes of seventh cervical and sometimes two upper thoracic vertebrae; insertion: spinous processes of axis and sometimes of second to fourth cervical vertebrae; innervation: branches of cervical; action: extends vertebral column.

label: spinal muscle of thorax
definition: Origin: spinous processes of two upper lumbar and two lower thoracic; insertion: spines of upper thoracic vertebrae; innervation: branches of spinal nerves; action: extends vertebral column.

label: mesenchymal cell
definition: An undifferentiated cell found in mesenchyme and capable of differentiating into various specialized connective tissues.

label: venule
definition: A small vein, especially one joining capillaries to larger veins.

label: UCI-101 cell
definition: Human ovarian cancer cell line.

label: glume
definition: One of the two chaffy basal bracts of a grass spikelet.

label: 4a-2s4 cell
definition: Anopheles gambiae cell line established from newly hatched larvae via a homogenization technique.

label: L3-5-3 cell
definition: Anopheles gambiae cell line established from newly hatched larvae via a homogenization technique.

label: Sua1.1 cell
definition: Anopheles gambiae cell line established from newly hatched larvae via a homogenization technique.

label: 1HAEo cell
definition: 1HAEo- cells are SV40-transformed normal human airway epithelial cells.

label: Hs 925.T cell
definition: Human skin pagetoid sarcoma cell line.

label: NS20Y cell
definition: Mouse neuroblastoma cell line established from a A/Jax mouse strain with neuroblastoma C1300. Cells were described to be aneuploid and to contain high specific activity of choline acetyltransferase.

label: CHO-EM9 cell
definition: This line is a derivative of the CHO-K1 cell line. EM9 is a repair deficient mutant derived from AA8.

label: CHO-AA8 cell
definition: This line is a derivative of the CHO-K1 cell line. The AA8 line has 21 chromosomes and is heterozygous at the aprt locus.

label: A2780/DX3 cell
definition: Doxorubicin-resistant ovarian-cancer cell line.

label: cortical collecting duct
definition: The cortical collecting ducts receive filtrate from multiple initial collecting tubules and descend into the renal medulla to form medullary collecting ducts.

label: CCD-13Lu cell
definition: Human normal lung fibroblast cell line established from a black 71-years-old human male. Derived from normal tissue from a patient with pancreatic carcinoma.

label: CCD-8Lu cell
definition: Human normal lung fibroblast cell line established from a caucasian 48-years-old human male. Derived from normal tissue from patient who died of cerebral thrombosis.

label: CCD-25Lu cell
definition: Human normal lung fibroblast cell line established from a caucasian 7-years-old human male. The line was established from the lung of a patient who died of glioma of the brain stem.

label: CCD-27Sk cell
definition: Human normal lung fibroblast cell line established from a black 23-weeks-gestation-old human male. The line was derived from normal skin of a neonate that died of complications following premature birth.

label: ROS-17/2.8 cell
definition: Osteosarcoma cell line.

label: B35 cell
definition: Rattus norvegicus (rat) central nervous system (CNS) neuroblastoma cell line. Rats were inoculated with N-nitrosoethylurea (NEU) 15 days after conception. Tumors found in the central nervous system (CNS) 4 to 10 months after birth were excised, minced, adapted to culture and cloned.

label: entorhinal area
