definition: Cystic fibrosis affects the exocrine glands and is characterized by the production of abnormal secretions, leading to mucous build-up. This accumulation of mucus can impair the pancreas and, secondarily, the intestine. Mucous build-up in lungs tends progressively to impair respiration.

label: medullary collecting duct cell
definition: Medullary collecting ducts are divided into outer and inner segments, the latter reaching more deeply into the medulla. The variable reabsorption of water and, depending on fluid balances and hormonal influences, the reabsorption or secretion of sodium, potassium, hydrogen and bicarbonate ion continues here.

label: medullary collecting duct
definition: Medullary collecting ducts are divided into outer and inner segments, the latter reaching more deeply into the medulla. The variable reabsorption of water and, depending on fluid balances and hormonal influences, the reabsorption or secretion of sodium, potassium, hydrogen and bicarbonate ion continues here.

label: cortical collecting duct cell
definition: The cortical collecting ducts receive filtrate from multiple initial collecting tubules and descend into the renal medulla to form medullary collecting ducts.

label: initial collecting tubule
definition: The initial collecting tubule is a segment with a constitution similar as the collecting duct, but before the convergence with other tubules.

label: connecting tubule
definition: With respect to the renal corpuscle, the connecting tubule is the most proximal part of the collecting duct system. It is adjacent to the distal convoluted tubule, the most distal segment of the renal tubule. Connecting tubules from several adjacent nephrons merge to form cortical collecting tubules, and these may join to form cortical collecting ducts. Connecting tubules of some juxtamedullary nephrons may arch upward, forming an arcade. The connecting tubule derives from the metanephric blastema, but the rest of the system derives from the ureteric bud. Because of this, some sources group the connecting tubule as part of the nephron, rather than grouping it with the collecting duct system.

label: papillary duct
definition: The terminal portions of the medullary collecting ducts are the papillary ducts, which end at the renal papilla and empty into a minor calyx.

label: connecting tubule cell
definition: For the connecting tubules, the specific cell type is the connecting tubule cell.

label: principal cell
definition: For the collecting ducts, the specific cell type is the principal cell.

label: inner medullary collecting duct cell
definition: For the inner medullary collecting duct, the specific cell type is the inner medullary collecting duct cell.

label: M-1 collecting duct cell

label: superficial inguinal lymph node
definition: A group of 12-20 lymph nodes that lie in the subcutaneous tissue below the inguinal ligament and along the terminal part of the great saphenous vein; they drain the skin and subcutaneous tissue of the lower abdominal wall, perineum, buttocks, external genitalia, and lower limbs.

label: proximal deep inguinal lymph node

label: parotid gland duct

label: submandibular gland duct

label: sublingual gland duct
definition: The duct associated with sublingual salivary gland. Located on the floor of the oral cavity, inferior to the tongue.

label: thymic medulla
definition: Histologically, the thymus can be divided into a central medulla and a peripheral cortex which is surrounded by an outer capsule. The cortex and medulla play different roles in the development of T cells. Cells in the thymus can be divided into thymic stromal cells and cells of hematopoietic origin.

label: thymic stromal cell

label: thymic cortical epithelial cell
definition: Thymic stromal cells include thymic cortical epithelial cells, thymic medullary epithelial cells, and dendritic cells.

label: thymic medullary epithelial cell
definition: Thymic stromal cells include thymic cortical epithelial cells, thymic medullary epithelial cells, and dendritic cells.

label: thymic dendritic cell
definition: Thymic stromal cells include thymic cortical epithelial cells, thymic medullary epithelial cells, and dendritic cells.

label: Rb-1 cell

label: sessile serrated adenoma cell
definition: In gastroenterology, a sessile serrated adenoma is a premalignant flat or sessile lesions of the colon. SSAs are thought to lead to colorectal cancer through the serrated pathway.

label: supportive connective tissue
definition: Classified as supportive connective tissue are bone, osseous tissue, that makes up virtually the entire skeleton in adult vertebrates and cartilage makes up virtually the entire skeleton in chondrichthyes. In most other vertebrates, it is found primarily in joints, where it provides cushioning.

label: ovarian fluid
definition: The ovarian fluid surrounds eggs from female fish.

label: ulcer tissue

label: L3.3 cell

label: HEP-G2/2.2.1 cell

label: BOSC-23 cell

label: nephroblastoma cell
definition: A cancerous tumour of the kidney in children. Wilms is the most common tumour of the kidney and the most common intra-abdominal tumour in children. The exact cause is unknown, but probably develops in foetal tissue due to an underlying genetic factor.

label: smooth muscle cell
definition: Muscle tissue that lacks cross striations, that is made up of elongated spindle-shaped cells having a central nucleus, and that is found in vertebrate visceral structures (as the stomach and bladder) as thin sheets performing functions not subject to conscious control by the mind and in all or most of the musculature of invertebrates other than arthropods.

label: vascular smooth muscle cell
definition: Vascular smooth muscle refers to the particular type of smooth muscle found within, and composing the majority of the wall of blood vessels.

label: parenchyma of thyroid gland

label: acute promyelocytic leukemia cell
definition: A subtype of acute myelogenous leukemia (AML), a cancer of the blood and bone marrow. In APL, there is an abnormal accumulation of immature granulocytes called promyelocytes.

label: alevin

definition: Oral squamous cell carcinoma cell line.

label: NHEC cell
definition: Human normal nasal epithelial cell line.

label: bone matrix
definition: The intercellular substance of bone tissue consisting of collagen fibers, ground substance, and inorganic bone salts.

label: epiblast
definition: The upper layer of the bilaminar embryonic disc present during the second week of a blastula that gives rise to the ectoderm after gastrulation.

label: CWR-22 cell
definition: Androgen-dependent human prostate cancer cell line.

label: D-407 cell
definition: Human retinal pigment epithelial cell line.

label: garland cell
definition: The garland cell of Drosophila is a nephrocyte which takes up waste products from the haemolymph.

label: nephrocyte
definition: In most Arthropoda, one of the large phagocytic cells that accumulate waste products.

label: TE-15 cell
definition: Human esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cell line.

label: TE-13 cell
definition: Human esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cell line.

label: TE-8 cell
definition: Human esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cell line.

label: TE-1 cell
definition: Human esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cell line.

label: human aortic endothelial cell
definition: Human aortic endothelial cell line.

label: HBE cell
definition: Human bronchial epithelial cell line.

label: IEC-18 cell
definition: A nontransformed rat small intestine cell line.

label: U-118MG cell
definition: Human neuronal glioblastoma (grade III) cell line.

label: MDCK-1 cell
definition: Cell line was derived by cloning the parental cell line MDCK.

label: MDCK-2 cell
definition: Cell line was derived by cloning the parental cell line MDCK.

label: Henles loop
definition: The long U-shaped part of the renal tubule, extending through the medulla from the end of the proximal convoluted tubule. It begins with a descending limb comprising the proximal straight tubule and the thin tubule, followed by the ascending limb the distal straight tubule, and ending at the distal convoluted tubule.

label: TALH cell
definition: Cultures of rabbit immortalized thick ascending limb of Henles loop.

label: SW-900 cell
definition: Human lung squamous cell carcinoma grade IV. The tumor originated in the lung of a 53 year old male Caucasian.

label: WM-793B cell
definition: The WM793B line was established from skin taken from the primary melanoma of a vertical growth phase lesion taken from the sternum of a patient.

label: sebocyte
definition: These cells form sebaceous glands. Sebocytes are epithelial cells that originate from a basal cell layer at the periphery of the gland.

label: NOSE1 cell
definition: Normal human ovarian surface epithelial cell line.

label: stria terminalis
definition: A bundle of nerve fibers that passes from the amygdala along the demarcation between the thalamus and caudate nucleus mostly to the anterior part of the hypothalamus with a few fibers crossing the anterior commissure to the amygdala on the opposite side.

label: mucilage
definition: A gelatinous substance of various plants (as legumes or seaweeds) that contains protein and polysaccharides and is similar to plant gums .

label: T-289 cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: OCI-AML2 cell
definition: Human acute myeloid leukemia cell line; established from the peripheral blood of a 65-year-old man with acute myeloid leukemia.

label: OCI-AML3 cell
definition: Human acute myeloid leukemia cell line; established from the peripheral blood of a 57-year-old man with acute myeloid leukemia.

label: OCI-AML5 cell
definition: Human acute myeloid leukemia cell line; established from the peripheral blood of a 77-year-old man with acute myeloid leukemia.

label: OCI-M1 cell
definition: Human acute myeloid leukemia cell line; established from erythroleukemia blasts, AML M6, of a 62-year-old patient following a 7-year chlorambucil treatment for chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

label: OCI-M2 cell
definition: Human acute myelocytic leukemia cell line; established in 1984 from the leukemic cells of a 56-year-old patient with erythroleukemia, AML-M6, representing the end stage of a previously identified myelodysplastic syndrome.

label: YN-1 cell
definition: Human erythroleukemia cell line.

label: plasmacytoid dendritic cell
definition: The plasmacytoid dendritic cell, pDC, is a type of white blood cell. The primary function of this cell type is to produce type I interferon when the body is infected by a virus. The pDC has special surface receptors that can detect many types of viruses.

label: aortic valve
definition: One of the four valves in the heart, this valve is situated at exit of the left ventricle of the heart where the aorta begins. The aortic valve lets blood from the left ventricle be pumped up into the aorta but prevents blood once it is in the aorta from returning to the heart.

label: metaphloem
definition: The primary phloem that forms after differentiation of the protophloem.

label: glomerular endothelium
definition: The glomerular endothelium sits on a very thick glomerular basement membrane.

label: 29-13 cell
definition: Procyclic trypanosome cell line of Trypanosoma brucei.

label: peribronchial gland
definition: There are serous cells in the peribronchial gland of the lung.

label: TT2 ES cell
definition: Murine embryonic stem cell line; established from an F1 embryo between a C57BL/6 female and a CBA male.

label: FD-2 cell
definition: Farber disease dermal fibroblast cell line.

label: abductor
definition: Any muscle used to pull a body part away from the midline of the body. For example, the abductor muscles of the legs spread the legs away from the midline and away from one another. An abductor muscle opposes an adductor muscle.

label: fin
definition: An external membranous process of an aquatic animal as a fish used in propelling or guiding the body.

label: dorsal fin
definition: The unpaired fin located on the back of both bony fish and sharks. It may be single and soft-rayed, as in trout, or double with the anterior dorsal fin supported by fin spines, as in perch. In some species, e.g. eels, the dorsal fin is confluent with the tail fin.

label: pelvic fin
definition: One of the pair of fins positioned on the under-side of the body of a fish. Depending on the species, the pelvic fins can be found in a mid-ventral position underneath or just behind the pectoral fins or in front of the pectorals in the throat region.

label: anal fin
definition: The unpaired fin located on the ventral side of the body of a fish, posterior to the anus. It plays an important role in the swimming movements of sharks and bony fish.

label: pectoral fin
definition: In fish, one of the pair of fins that are situated one on each side of the fish just behind the gills. Normally they are used for balancing and braking, but in some species, e.g. Exocoetidae, flying fish, the extra-large fins are used for jumping and for gliding over the water surface.

label: Tet21N cell
definition: Human neuroblastoma cell line.

label: SK-ChA-1 cell
definition: Human cholangiocarcinoma cell line.

label: premonocyte
definition: An immature monocyte not normally present in the blood.

label: imaginal disc
definition: A group of undifferentiated cells in an insect larva that develops into a specific adult structure.

label: exoskeleton
definition: Exoskeleton or shell, including those of mollusks, turtles, insects and crustaceans.

label: human iliac artery endothelial cell
definition: Human arterial endothelial cells, HAECs, are isolated from adult human iliac arteries of transplant donors by mechanically removing the endothelial layer and are cultured.

label: iliac artery
definition: Either of the large arteries supplying blood to the lower trunk and hind limbs and arising by bifurcation of the aorta which in humans occurs at the level of the fourth lumbar vertebra to form one vessel for each side of the body.

label: external iliac artery
definition: The outer branch of the common iliac artery on either side of the body that passes beneath the inguinal ligament to become the femoral artery.

label: internal iliac artery
definition: The inner branch of the common iliac artery on either side of the body that soon breaks into several branches and supplies blood chiefly to the pelvic and gluteal areas.

label: hand
definition: 1. The terminal part of the vertebrate forelimb when modified, as in humans, as a grasping organ. 2. A part serving the function of or resembling a hand as the hind foot of an ape or the chela of a crustacean.

label: finger
definition: Any of the five terminating members of the hand, a digit of the forelimb.

label: interdigit
definition: The area of the hand or foot lying between adjacent digits.

label: hair medulla
definition: The medulla is the inner most layer of the hair shaft.

label: hair shaft
definition: The non-growing portion of a hair which protrudes from the skin, i.e., from the follicle.

label: dorsal aorta
definition: The artery in vertebrate embryos that transports blood from the aortic arches to the trunk and limbs. In adult fish it is a major artery that carries oxygenated blood from the efferent branchial arteries to branches that supply the body organ. In adult tetrapods it arises from the systemic arch.

label: ventral aorta
definition: The artery in vertebrate embryos that carries blood from the ventricle of the heart to the aortic arches. In adult fish it branches into afferent branchial arteries supplying the gills. In adult tetrapods it is represented by the ascending part of the aorta.

label: regio occipitalis capitis
definition: The surface region of the head corresponding to the outlines of the occipital bone.

label: cerebral peduncle
definition: Either of two large bundles of nerve fibers passing from the pons forward and outward to form the main connection between the cerebral hemispheres and the spinal cord.

label: basis pedunculi cerebri
definition: The large bundle of nerve fiber tracts forming the anterior part of the cerebral peduncles, which consists of corticospinal, corticonuclear, corticopontine, parietotemporopontine, and frontopontine fibers descending from the cerebral cortex and terminating in the pons and spinal cord.

label: regio frontalis capitis
definition: The surface region of the head corresponding to the outlines of the frontal bone.

label: capillary pericyte
definition: A cell with several slender processes that embraces the capillary wall in amphibia.

label: stratum basale
definition: The deepest layer, as of the epidermis or the endometrium. In the epidermis it is a single layer of cells. In the endometrium it provides the regenerative tissue after menstrual loss of the functional layer.

label: bursa copulatrix
definition: A thin fan or bell-shaped expansion of the cuticle of the tail of many male nematode worms that functions as a copulatory structure.

label: gential atrium
definition: A common chamber receiving openings of male, female, and accessory organs.

label: genital chamber
definition: A copulatory invagination. In females, sometimes forms a tubular vagina that is often developed to form a bursa copulatrix. In males, a ventral invagination containing the phallic organs.

label: genital pore
definition: A small opening on the side of the head in some gastropods through which the penis is protruded.

label: bony labyrinth
definition: The bony part of the internal ear.

label: cochlear labyrinth
definition: The part of the membranous labyrinth that includes the perilymphatic space and the cochlear duct.

label: orbit
definition: The bony socket of the eye.

label: regio orbitalis
definition: The region about the orbit.

label: external gill
definition: External gills are the gills of an animal, most typically an amphibian, that are exposed to the environment, rather than set inside the pharynx and covered by gill slits, as they are in most fishes.

label: arterial system
definition: The arterial system is the higher-pressure portion of the circulatory system.

label: hippocampus minor
definition: The lower of two elevations on the medial wall of the posterior horn of the lateral ventricle of the brain, caused by the depth of the calcarine sulcus.

label: venous system
definition: A system of interconnected blood vessels that returns blood to the heart from the tissue and capillary bed through progressively larger vessels.

label: regio parietalis capitis
definition: The surface region of the head corresponding to the outlines of the underlying parietal bone.

label: rectal sac
definition: The enlarged anterior part of the rectum, sometimes produced into a large rectal caecum.

label: aortic root
definition: The part of the aorta attached to the atrioventricular fibrous rings and myocardium.

label: external carotid artery
definition: In human anatomy, the external carotid artery is a major artery of the head and neck. It arises from the common carotid artery when it bifurcates into the external and internal carotid artery.

label: internal carotid artery
definition: In human anatomy, the internal carotid artery is a major artery of the head and neck that helps supply blood to the brain.

label: regio oralis
definition: The region of the face including the lips and mouth.

label: dorsal striatum
definition: Those portions of the caudate nucleus and especially the putamen located generally superior to a plane representing the anterior commissure; also called the dorsal basal ganglia; may function in motor activities with cognitive origins.

label: ventral striatum
definition: Those portions of the striatum located generally inferior to a plane representing the anterior commissure; includes the nucleus accumbens and some nuclei of the olfactory tubercle; may function in motor activities with emotional or motivational origins.

label: striate cortex
definition: The term visual cortex refers to the primary visual cortex and extrastriate visual cortical areas such as V2, V3, V4, and V5. The primary visual cortex is anatomically equivalent to Brodmann area 17, or BA17. There is a visual cortex for each hemisphere of the brain. The left hemisphere visual cortex receives signals from the right visual field and the right visual cortex from the left visual field.

label: extrastriate cortex
definition: The term visual cortex refers to the primary visual cortex and extrastriate visual cortical areas such as V2, V3, V4, and V5. The extrastriate cortical areas consist of Brodmann area 18 and Brodmann area 19. There is a visual cortex for each hemisphere of the brain. The left hemisphere visual cortex receives signals from the right visual field and the right visual cortex from the left visual field.

label: connecting stalk
definition: A bridge of mesoderm connecting the caudal end of the young embryo with the trophoblastic tissues; the precursor of the umbilical cord.

label: ankle joint
definition: A hinge joint formed by the articulating of the tibia and the fibula with the talus below.

label: hinge joint
definition: A joint that allows motion around an axis.

label: thyroid follicle
definition: Discrete, cystlike units of the thyroid gland that are lined with cuboidal epithelium and are filled with a colloid substance, about 30 to each lobule.

label: thyroid primordium
definition: In embryology, organ or tissue in its earliest recognizable stage of development. As, for example, the thyroid primordium.

label: tunica interna bulbi
definition: The third and deepest of the three layers of the eyeball, composed of the retina, intraocular part of the optic nerve, and the retinal blood vessels.

label: head capsule
definition: The insect's head is sometimes referred to as the head-capsule, and is the insect's feeding and sensory centre. It supports the eyes, antennae and jaws of the insect.

label: parathyroid hormone secreting cell
definition: Parathyroid hormone is secreted from cells of the parathyroid glands and finds its major target cells in bone and kidney.

label: larval ventral ganglion
definition: Abdominal neuromere of the larva. The larval ventral ganglion is less complex than the brain, consists of a smaller number of neurons and shows in general a homomeric composition. Despite its reduced complexity, the larval ventral ganglion possesses peptidergic interneurons as well as neurosecretory cells producing peptide hormones, and receives sensory inputs of different modalities.

label: palatine tonsil
definition: Palatine tonsils are the tonsils that can be seen on the left and right sides at the back of the throat.

label: nasopharyngeal tonsil
definition: The human palatine tonsils and the nasopharyngeal tonsil are lymphoepithelial tissues located in strategic areas of the oropharynx and nasopharynx.

label: null cell
definition: A null cell is a large granular lymphocyte without surface markers or membrane-associated proteins from B lymphocytes or T lymphocytes. Members of null cells are natural killer cells, antigen dependent cytotoxic cells and the lymphokine activated killer cells.

label: large granular lymphocyte
definition: A type of white blood cell that contains granules with enzymes that can kill tumor cells or microbial cells.

label: breast lobe
definition: The 15 to 20 separate portions of the mammary gland that radiate from the central area deep to the nipple like wheel spokes and comprise the body of the mammary gland; each is drained by a single lactiferous duct.

label: excretory canal cell
definition: The H-shaped excretory cell is the largest cell in Caenorabditis elegans.

label: mural cell
definition: A nonendothelial cell enclosed within the basement membrane of retinal capillaries.

label: myeloid dendritic cell
definition: The most common division of dendritic cells is myeloid versus plasmacytoid. The myeloid dendritic cells are developed from myeloid precursors and are most similar to monocytes. They are made up of at least two subsets: 1. the more common mDC-1, which is a major stimulator of T cells and 2. the extremely rare mDC-2, which may have a function in fighting wound infection. They secrete IL-12.

label: plasmacytoid T-lymphocyte
definition: These cells constitute a population of medium-sized mononuclear cells with plasmacytoid features in the T-cell zones of human lymphoid tissues, and in the thymus and lymph nodes of patients with various inflammatory and neoplastic diseases. They have been shown to express several antigens expressed on myelomonocytes, monocytes, and macrophages but lack markers for B-cells and plasma cells.

label: lymphoid dendritic cell
definition: Dendritic cells that develop from lymphoid precursors.

label: animal cap
definition: In Xenopus embryos the animal cap, which is the area around the animal pole of the blastula, is destined to form the ectoderm during normal development. However, these cells retain pluripotentiality and upon exposure to specific inducers, the animal cap can differentiate into neural, mesodermal, and endodermal tissues. In this sense, the cells of the animal cap are equivalent to mammalian embryonic stem cells.

label: rheumatoid arthritis disease specific synovial fluid
peripheral blood lymphocyte
definition: Peripheral blood lymphocytes are mature lymphocytes that circulate in the blood, rather than localising to organs, such as the spleen or lymph nodes. They comprise T cells, NK cells and B cells.

label: myeloid progenitor cell
definition: One of the two stem cells derived from hematopoietic stem cells, the other being the lymphoid progenitor cell. Derived from these myeloid progenitor cells are the erythroid progenitor cells and the myeloid cells.

label: lymphoid progenitor cell
definition: One of the two stem cells derived from hematopoietic stem cells, the other being the myeloid progenitor cell. Derived from these myeloid progenitor cells are the erythroid progenitor cells and the myeloid cells.

label: bone marrow-derived macrophage
definition: Bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMM) are primary macrophage cells, derived from bone marrow cells in vitro in the presence of growth factors.

label: gravid adult
definition: Containing a developing embryo, fetus, or unborn offspring within the body.

label: HBL-100 cell
definition: Human mammary gland breast carcinoma cell line, established from a 27 years old caucasian female.

label: brainstem glioma cell
definition: This primary brain tumour occurs in the pons or the medulla. They account for approximately 15% of brain tumours in children. Symptoms include double vision, facial weakness, vomiting and difficulty walking. Surgery is difficult due to location so radiation therapy and chemotherapy are used. Overall survival is 20 to 30%.

label: B-CPAP cell
definition: Human papillary thyroid carcinoma derived cell line.

label: AU-565 cell
definition: The AU565 cell line was derived from a pleural effusion of a patient with breast adenocarcinoma. This cell line was established from the same patient as SK-BR-3. The patient, a White, Caucasian female, age 43, blood type A+, had been treated with radiation, steroids, cytoxan and 5-fluorouracil.

label: CFPAC-1 cell
definition: This line was derived from a pancreatic duct adenocarcinoma (liver metastasis) from a patient with cystic fibrosis.

label: CGTH-W3 cell
definition: Papillary thyroid cancer cell line.

label: CGTH-W1 cell
definition: Follicular thyroid cancer cell line.

label: CGTH-W2 cell
definition: Follicular thyroid cancer cell line.

label: HCT-115 cell
definition: Human colon cancer cell line.

label: HCT-166 cell
definition: Human colon carcinoma cell line.

label: hair cell
definition: Hair cells are the sensory receptors of both the auditory system and the vestibular system in all vertebrates. In mammals, the auditory hair cells are located within the organ of Corti on a thin basilar membrane in the cochlea of the inner ear.

label: INA-6 cell
definition: A human myeloma cell line established from patient with IgG-kappa plasma cell leukemia .

label: NCI-H716 cell
definition: A cell line derived from a poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma of the caecum.

label: metula
definition: A sterile cell below the phialides of some Aspergillus and Penicillium species.

label: phialide
definition: A specialized conidiogenous cell that produces conidia in basipetal succession without increasing in length.

label: 129S6 cell
definition: The PluriStem 129S6 Murine ES cell line is derived from the widely used 129/S6/SvEv strain of mice.

label: 1C9 cell
definition: Lexicon ES cell line 1C9 from parental mouse strain 129/SvEvBrd.

label: adipose-derived stromal cell
definition: Adipose-derived stromal cells have been shown to have multiple lineage differentiation properties and to be suitable for tissues regeneration in many degenerative processes.

label: XP-V XP30RO cell
definition: SV40-transformed polymerase- eta-deficient XP30RO fibroblasts were derived from an Xeroderma pigmentosum variant (XP-V) patient.

label: VERO-76 cell
definition: Monkey (Cercopithecus aethiops) kidney endothelial cell line. It is a derivative of the original VERO.

label: VERO C1008 cell
definition: This line is a clone of VERO 76.

label: TF-1 cell
definition: Human bone marrow erythroleukemia cell line. The TF-1 cell line has been established in October 1987 from a heparinized bone marrow aspiration sample from a 35 year old Japanese male with severe pancytopenia.

label: TF-1 BCR-ABL cell
definition: We used TF-1 BCR/ABL cells, by introducing the BCR/ABL gene into the TF-1 leukemia cell line.

label: TSM1 cell
definition: Murine neocortical neuronal cell line.

label: V866 cell
definition: Human somatic proximal cecum colonic cancer cell line, established from a caucasian male.

label: V400 cell
definition: Human somatic proximal colonic cancer cell line, established from a caucasian male.

label: UKE-1 cell
definition: Acute myeloid leukemia cell line.

label: SET-2 cell
definition: Acute myeloid leukemia cell line. Human essential thrombocythemia cell line; established from the peripheral blood of a 71-year-old woman with essential thrombocythemia at megakaryoblastic leukemic transformation.

label: MB-02 cell
definition: Acute myeloid leukemia cell line.

label: MUTZ-8 cell
definition: Acute myeloid leukemia cell line.

label: teratocyte
definition: In Lepidoptera Pieridae, unicellular forms resulting from the embryonic membranes of parasitic Braconidae.

label: TAD-2 cell
definition: Immortalized normal thyroid cell line.

label: NPA cell
definition: Papillary thyroid tumor cell line.

label: WRO cell
definition: Follicular thyroid tumor cell line.

label: trophoblast stem cell line
definition: Tanaka et al have reported that a culture of mouse blastocysts or early postimplantation trophoblasts in the presence of FGF-4 permits the isolation of permanent trophoblast stem cell lines.

label: trophoblast stem cell
definition: Tanaka et al have reported that a culture of mouse blastocysts or early postimplantation trophoblasts in the presence of FGF-4 permits the isolation of permanent trophoblast stem cell lines.

label: SUP-M2 cell
definition: Human anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL) cell line; derived from the cerebrospinal fluid of a 5-year-old girl with refractory malignant histiocytosis.

label: striatonigral neuron
definition: Neuron projecting from the corpus striatum to the substantia nigra.

label: RSC96 cell
definition: Spontaneously immortalized rat Schwann cell line, derived from long-term culture of rat primary Schwann cells.

label: medium spiny neuron
definition: A special type of inhibitory cells representing approximately 90% of the neurons within the corpus striatum of the basal ganglia. They play a key role in initiating and controlling movements of the body, limbs and eyes.

label: soft tissue sarcoma cell
definition: A malignant tumor that begins in the muscle, fat, fibrous tissue, blood vessels, or other "soft" supporting tissues of the body. Soft tissue sarcomas do not originate in bone or cartilage.

label: SK-RC-26B cell
definition: Human renal cell carcinoma cell line.

label: SK-N-BE(2)C cell
definition: Human neuroblastoma cell line.

label: SeAx cell
definition: The SeAx cell line is derived from peripheral blood of a patient with Sezary syndrome, a common type of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.

label: HFF-1 cell
definition: Human normal foreskin fibroblast cell line; pooled from two male newborn individuals.

label: Ewing's sarcoma family tumor cell line
definition: Ewing sarcoma family of tumors (ESFT) belong to the group of neoplasms commonly referred to as small, round, blue-cell tumors of childhood.

label: SCMC-ES1 cell
definition: Ewing's sarcoma family tumor cell line.

label: SK-N-LO cell
definition: Ewing's sarcoma family tumor cell line.

label: KP-EW-MS cell
definition: Ewing's sarcoma family tumor cell line.

label: hTERT-RPE1 cell
definition: The hTERT-immortalized retinal pigment epithelial cell line, hTERT RPE-1, was derived by transfecting the RPE-340 cell line with the pGRN145 hTERT-expressing plasmid.

label: root primordium
definition: Different primordial types like the leaf and flower primordia arise from the shoot lateral meristem.

label: RHEK-1 cell
definition: The human epidermal keratinocyte line, designated RHEK-1, was used at passage 23 for these transformation studies. This cell line was established from primary foreskin epidermal keratinocytes after infection with the Adl2-SV40 hybrid virus.

label: TC1 cell
definition: Immunized T-lymphocytes which can directly destroy appropriate target cells. These CD8-positive cells are distinct from natural killer cells and from KILLER CELLS mediating antibody-dependent cell cytotoxicity. There are two effector phenotypes: TC1 and TC2.

label: TC2 cell
definition: Immunized T-lymphocytes which can directly destroy appropriate target cells. These CD8-positive cells are distinct from natural killer cells and from KILLER CELLS mediating antibody-dependent cell cytotoxicity. There are two effector phenotypes: TC1 and TC2.

label: JHU-1 cell
definition: The tumor cell line was derived from primary lung epithelial cells of C57BL/6 mice.

label: 253J cell
definition: Human bladder transitional cell carcinoma cell line.

label: accessory olfactory bulb
definition: The accessory olfactory bulb, which resides on the dorsal-posterior region of the main olfactory bulb, forms a parallel pathway independent from the main olfactory bulb. It is the second processing stage of the accessory olfactory system. It receives axonal input from the vomeronasal organ, a distinct sensory epithelium from the main olfactory epithelium that detects pheromones, among other chemical stimuli. Like the main olfactory bulb, axonal input to the accessory olfactory bulb forms synapses with mitral cells within glomeruli. However, mitral cells in the accessory olfactory bulb project their axons to targets in the amygdala and hypothalamus where they may influence aggressive and mating behavior.

label: accessory sex gland
definition: Male accessory glands in humans are the seminal vesicles, prostate gland, and the bulbourethral glands. In insects, male accessory glands produce products that mix with the sperm to protect and preserve them.

label: LNCaP-AI cell
definition: Androgen-independent LNCaP cell line. A prostate cancer cell line, that proliferates under androgen-depleted conditions after emerging from long-term, androgen- depleted culture of the androgen-sensitive prostate cancer cell line LNCaP.

label: amnioserosa
definition: The amnioserosa is an extraembryonic, epithelial tissue that covers the dorsal side of the Drosophila embryo.

label: ML-DmBG3-c2 cell
definition: Cell line from Drosophila larval central nervous system.

label: OCL-1 cell
definition: Human ovarian carcinoma line.

label: C666-1 cell
definition: A cell line from undifferentiated nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). This cell line consistently carries the Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) in long-term cultures. C666-1 is a subclone of its parental cell line, C666, derived from an NPC xenograft of southern Chinese origin.

label: CHO-91-47-67 cell
definition: CHO-K1 cells were stably transfected with one or more plasmids for expression of gp91phox, p47phox, and p67phox.

label: CHO-91-22-47-67 cell
definition: CHO-K1 cells were stably transfected with one or more plasmids for expression of gp91phox, p22phox, p47phox, and p67phox.

label: CHO-91-22 cell
definition: CHO-K1 cells were stably transfected with one or more plasmids for expression of gp91phox and p22phox.

label: CHO-91 cell
definition: CHO-K1 cells were stably transfected with one or more plasmids for expression of gp91phox.

label: CHO-22 cell
definition: CHO-K1 cells were stably transfected with one or more plasmids for expression of p22phox.

label: Clara cell
definition: Clara cells are specialized non-ciliated epithelial cells in the terminal bronchioles of mammals and in the upper airways of some species such as mice.

label: dermal dendritic cell
definition: A key cell type of the resident skin immune system is the dendritic cell, which in normal skin is located in two distinct microanatomical compartments: Langerhans cells (LC) mainly in the epidermis and dermal dendritic cells (DDC) in the dermis.

label: DMS-114 cell
definition: The line was established from cells from a mediastinal biopsy of a patient with small cell carcinoma of the lung.

label: DT-40 cell
definition: Chicken B cell line; established in 1985 from a bursal lymphoma, which was induced by infection of a 1 day old chicken with Rous-associated virus type 1 (RAV-1), an avian leukosis retrovirus carrying no cell-derived oncogene.

label: ER-1 cell
definition: The ER-1 weakly malignant clonal cell line was derived from a mammary adenocarcinoma that developed spontaneously in a female SHR rat.

label: ERpP cell
definition: ER-1 cells converted into highly tumorigenic and metastatic cells, ERpP, by subcutaneous co-inoculation with plastic plates.

label: extraradical hypha
definition: Extraradical hypha, of arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi, are formed outside roots and absorbing nutrients from the soil and binding its grains into aggregates.

label: FOM71 cell
definition: Human primary melanocyte cell line.

label: FOM78 cell
definition: Human primary melanocyte cell line.

label: NHEM693 cell
definition: Human primary melanocyte cell line.

label: NHEM2493 cell
definition: Human primary melanocyte cell line.

label: germ tube
definition: A germ tube is an outgrowth produced by certain species of spore-releasing fungi (sporangia) during germination. The germ tube differentiates, grows, and develops by mitosis to create a somatic hyphae.

label: NCI-H1355 cell
definition: Human lung adenocarcinoma cell line from a pleural effusion stage 4.

label: NCI-H1975 cell
definition: Human non-small cell lung cancer cell line.

label: NCI-H524 cell
definition: Human variant small cell lung cancer cell line; derived from lymph node metastasis from a 63 years old caucasian male.

label: HFF2/T cell
definition: Human foreskin fibroblasts immortalized by human telomerase reverse-transcriptase.

label: hFOB cell
definition: Immortalized human fetal osteoblastic cell line.

label: HGC-27 cell
definition: This human gastric carcinoma cell line was established by culture of the metastatic lymph node from a gastric cancer patient diagnosed histological as undifferentiated carcinoma.

label: HOB-c cell
definition: Normal human hipbone osteoblast cell line.

label: JB6 cell
definition: Mouse epidermal cell line.

label: L56Br-C1 cell
definition: A human tumor xenograft (L56Br-X1) was established from a breast cancer axillary lymph node metastasis of a 53-year-old woman with a BRCA1 germ-line nonsense mutation (1806C>T; Q563X), and a cell line (L56Br-C1) was subsequently derived from the xenograft.

label: large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma cell

definition: The artery that serves blood to the penis. It subdivides into three arteries, the bulbourethral artery, the dorsal artery of the penis and the cavernosal artery.

label: arteria profunda penis
definition: The artery that serves blood to the penis. It subdivides into three arteries, the bulbourethral artery, the dorsal artery of the penis and the cavernosal artery.

label: arteria bulbi penis
definition: The common penile artery subdivides into three arteries, the bulbourethral artery, the dorsal artery of the penis and the cavernosal artery.

label: arteria dorsalis penis
definition: The artery that serves blood to the penis. It subdivides into three arteries, the bulbourethral artery, the dorsal artery of the penis and the cavernosal artery.

label: perichondrium
definition: A dense membrane composed of fibrous connective tissue that closely wraps (invests) all cartilage, except the cartilage in joints which is covered by a synovial membrane.

label: inner chondrogenic layer of perichondrium
definition: The perichondrium consists of two separate layers: an outer fibrous layer and inner chondrogenic layer. The chondrogenic layer remains undifferentiated and can form chondroblasts or chondrocytes.

label: outer fibrous layer of perichondrium
definition: The perichondrium consists of two separate layers: an outer fibrous layer and inner chondrogenic layer. The fibrous layer contains fibroblasts, which produce collagenous fibers.

label: intercalated cell
definition: Each component of the collecting duct system contains two cell types, intercalated cells and a segment-specific cell type.

label: leaf sheath
definition: The basal part of a grass leaf that encircles the stem.

label: H4-C99 cell
definition: H4 neuroglioma cells expressing intracellular amyloid beta precursor protein (APP) C99.

label: epithelial stem cell
definition: Epithelial stem cells in the lining of the digestive tract occur in deep crypts and give rise to several cell types: absorptive cells, goblet cells, paneth cells, and enteroendocrine cells.

label: skin stem cell
definition: Skin stem cells occur in the basal layer of the epidermis and at the base of hair follicles.

label: epidermal stem cell
definition: The epidermal stem cells give rise to keratinocytes, which migrate to the surface of the skin and form a protective layer.

label: follicular stem cell
definition: The follicular stem cells can give rise to both the hair follicle and to the epidermis.

label: implantation fossa
definition: At the base of the head is a ball-and-socket articulation which serves to attach the neck and the rest of the spermatozoon to the head.

label: SCC-15 cell
definition: Human tongue squamous cell carcinoma cell line.

label: NB-1 cell
definition: Human neuroblastoma cell line.

label: ameloblastoma cell
definition: A tumor of the jaw derived from remnants of the embryonic rudiment of tooth enamel.

label: HaCaT II-4 cell
definition: The low-grade malignant cell line HaCaT II-4 is derived from the immortalized human keratinocyte cell line HaCaT (27) after transfection with the c-Ha-ras oncogene.

label: TRAMP-C1 cell
definition: This cell line was derived in 1996 from a heterogeneous 32 week primary tumor in the prostate of a PB-Tag C57BL/6 (TRAMP) mouse.

label: TRAMP-C3 cell
definition: This cell line was derived in 1996 from a heterogeneous 32 week primary tumor in the prostate of a PB-Tag C57BL/6 (TRAMP) mouse.

label: TRAMP-C2 cell
definition: This cell line was derived in 1996 from a heterogeneous 32 week primary tumor in the prostate of a PB-Tag C57BL/6 (TRAMP) mouse.

label: salivary duct
definition: An intralobular duct found in salivary glands and involved in the production and transport of their secretions.

label: RGC-5 cell
definition: Murine retinal ganglion cell line.

label: pleural mesothelioma cell
definition: A cell from a tumor derived from pleural mesothelial tissue.

label: neuroectodermal tumor cell
definition: A neuroectodermal tumor is a tumor of the central or peripheral nervous system.

label: PC3-B1 cell
definition: The PC3B1 cells were isolated from the bone marrow of severe combined immunodeficient (SCID) mice that had been injected 6 weeks previously with the PC3 cell line. The bone marrow containing the tumor cells was retrieved with PBS and the PC3B1 cells were propagated in tissue culture.

label: ovarian cyst
definition: Ovarian cysts are small fluid-filled sacs that develop in a woman's ovaries.

label: ovarian cyst fluid
definition: Ovarian cysts are small fluid-filled sacs that develop in a woman's ovaries.

label: platysma muscle
definition: The platysma is a superficial muscle that overlaps the sternocleidomastoid.

label: sternocleidomastoid muscle
definition: In human anatomy is a paired muscle in the superficial layers of the anterior portion of the neck. It acts to flex and rotate the head.

label: Myc-CaP cell
definition: Androgen-dependent prostate cancer cell line.

label: MCF-10A neoT cell
definition: Ras-transformed human breast epithelial cells.

label: M12 prostate cancer cell
definition: Highly tumorigenic, metastatic human prostate cell line. The M12 line was derived from the P69 line by selection for tumor formation in nude mice and is tumorigeneic and metastatic.

label: A2780/S cell
definition: Anthracycline-sensitive human ovarian carcinoma cell line.

label: A2780/R cell
definition: Anthracycline-resistant human ovarian carcinoma cell line.

label: arrector pili muscle
definition: Small, smooth muscle attached to the bulb of the hair which causes erection of the hair and compression of the attending sebaceous gland when it contracts.

label: CCD-986Sk cell
definition: Human normal skin fibroblast cell line. The line was established from skin taken from normal breast tissue removed during breast reduction mammoplasty.

label: adenomatoid odontogenic tumor cell
definition: The adenomatoid odontogenic tumor is an odontogenic tumor arising from the enamel organ or dental lamina.

label: D-283MED cell
definition: Human medulloblastoma cell line.

label: ES-E14 cell
definition: Mouse embryonic stem cell line.

label: RST-307 cell
definition: RST 307 cells were generated from E14 cells by insertion of a genetrap in exon 9 of (P)RR gene, precluding full-length (P)RR synthesis.

label: MTC-1 cell
definition: A mouse T cell hybridoma cell line that constitutively expresses CD103.

label: HEp-3 cell
definition: Human epidermoid-carcinoma cell line that expresses urokinase-type plasminogen activator u-PA and u-PAR.

label: H273 cell
definition: H1299 cells were transfected with pCMV-p53H273 plasmid. The H273 differs from the wild-type p53 by an arginine to histidine conversion at nucleotides 273. Clones were selected in the presence of G418 for 4 weeks and screened for p53 expression. Mutant p53 H273 has been reported to have strong transactivating activity.

label: rheumatoid arthritis disease specific giant cell
definition: The term giant cell arteritis is often used because when one looks at biopsies of inflamed temporal arteries under a microscope, one often sees large or giant cells.

label: ameloblastic layer
definition: The inner layer of cells of the enamel organ, which forms the enamel prisms of the teeth.

label: OCUT-2 cell
definition: Human undifferentiated thyroid cancer cell line.

label: KTC-1 cell
definition: Human undifferentiated thyroid cancer cell line.

label: HTh-7 cell
definition: Human anaplastic thyroid carcinoma cell line.

label: HTh-74 cell
definition: Human anaplastic thyroid carcinoma cell line.

label: HTh-83 cell
definition: Human anaplastic thyroid carcinoma cell line.

label: C-643 cell
definition: Human anaplastic thyroid carcinoma cell line.

label: anococcygeus muscle
definition: The anococcygeus muscle (AcM) is one of a pair of thin sheets of smooth muscle inserting on the rectum, having a tendinous origin largely on sacral vertebrae.

label: anterior horn
definition: One of the hornlike projections of gray matter into the white matter of the spinal cord. The anterior horn contains efferent fibers innervating skeletal muscle tissue.

label: A2780/CDDP cell
definition: Cisplatin resistant variant of the A2780 human ovarian carcinoma cell line.

label: CEM-VBL10 cell
definition: The CEM-VBL10 cell line is a multidrug-resistant derivative of the drugsensitive CEM cell line obtained by selection in medium containing 10 ng/ml respectively of vinblastine.

label: CEM-VBL16 cell
definition: The CEM-VBL16 cell line is a multidrug-resistant derivative of the drugsensitive CEM cell line obtained by selection in medium containing 16 ng/ml respectively of vinblastine.

label: CEM-VBL100 cell
definition: The CEM-VBL100 cell line is a multidrug-resistant variant of the derivative of the CCRF-CEM cell line.

label: Caco-2/BBe cell
definition: The C2BBe1 (brush border expressing) cell line was cloned in 1988 from the Caco-2 cell line by limiting dilution.

label: juxtaglomerular apparatus
definition: The juxtaglomerular apparatus is a microscopic structure in the kidney, which regulates the function of each nephron. The juxtaglomerular apparatus is named for its proximity to the glomerulus. It is found between the vascular pole of the renal corpuscle and the returning distal convoluted tubule of the same nephron. This location is critical to its function in regulating renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate. The three cellular components of the apparatus are the macula densa, extraglomerular mesangial cells, and juxtaglomerular cells.

label: juxtaglomerular cell
definition: One of the three cellular components of the juxtaglomerular apparatus. Juxtaglomerular cells are not granular cells but are granulated as they release renin.

label: extraglomerular mesangial cell
definition: One of the three cellular components of the juxtaglomerular apparatus.

label: oil gland
definition: A gland, such as a sebaceous gland, that secretes an oily substance.

label: KAT-18 cell
definition: Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma cell line.

label: FB-1 cell
definition: A human anaplastic thyroid cancer cell line, derived from a 68-year-old woman who underwent surgery for anaplastic thyroid cancer.

label: COLO-16 cell
definition: Human squamous carcinoma cell line.

label: HKESC-1 cell
definition: Cell line, established from a primary moderately-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma of the esophagus from a 47-year-old Hong Kong Chinese man.

label: HKESC-2 cell
definition: Human esophageal cancer cell line, established from a moderately differentiated ESCC of a 46-year-old Chinese woman from Hong Kong.

label: HKESC-3 cell
definition: Human esophageal cancer cell line, established from a well-differentiated ESCC of a 74-year-old Chinese man from Hong Kong.

label: HSC-1 cell
definition: Human cutaneous squamous carcinoma cell line.

label: JJ012 cell
definition: Human chondrosarcoma cell line.

label: HCMEC cell
definition: HCMEC are isolated from heart ventricles from a single donor.

label: keratocyte
definition: The fibroblastic stromal cell of the cornea. Keratocytes produce keratan-sulfate proteoglycans (KSPG), lumican and keratocan to form and sustain proper collagen interfibrillar spacing and fibril diameter of the cornea.

label: SNU-620 cell
definition: Human gastric cancer cell line.

label: MDA-MB-231-Luc2 cell
definition: A luciferase expressing cell line which was stably transfected with firefly luciferase gene (luc2). The cell line was established by transducing lentivirus containing luciferase 2 gene under the control of human ubiquitin C promoter.

label: UMR-106-01 cell
definition: Rat osteosarcoma osteoblastlike cell line.

label: Mel120 cell
definition: Human metastatic melanoma cell line.

label: Panc-02 cell
definition: Pancreatic tumor cell line, which is syngeneic to C57BL/6 mice.

label: L-540 cell
definition: Human Hodgkin lymphoma cell line,	established from the bone marrow of a 20-year-old woman with Hodgkin lymphoma (nodular sclerosis; stage IVB, pre-terminal stage).

label: BCWM.1 cell
definition: Derived from a long-term culture of CD19(+) selected bone marrow lymphoplasmacytic cells isolated from an untreated patient with Waldenström's macroglobulinemia.

label: PWR-1E cell
definition: Human prostatic epithelial cells, derived from a normal prostate with mild hyperplasia, were immortalized with an adenovirus 12-SV40 hybrid virus (Ad12-SV40). PWR-1E cell line was derived by single cell cloning of a non-producer cell.

label: PSN-1 cell
definition: Human pancreatic adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: pterygium
definition: A fleshy mass of thickened conjunctiva that grows over part of the cornea usually from the inner side of the eyeball and causes a disturbance of vision.

label: RzM6-LC cell
definition: HCV-expressing human hepatoblastoma-derived cell line.

label: TOV-112D cell
definition: This cell line was initiated in October of 1992 from a patient with early onset ovarian cancer. The patient was of French-Canadian descent with an unknown family history of ovarian cancer.

label: TOV-21G cell
definition: This cell line was initiated in October of 1991 from a patient of French-Canadian descent with no family history of ovarian cancer.

label: SVGp12 cell
definition: The SVG p12 cell line was established by transfecting cultured human fetal glial cells from brain material dissected from 8 to 12 week old embryos with DNA from an ori - mutant of SV40.

label: chondroma cell
definition: A chondroma is a benign cartilaginous tumor, which is encapsulated with a lobular growing pattern. Tumor cells (chondrocytes, cartilaginous cells) resemble normal cells and produce the cartilaginous matrix (amorphous, basophilic material).

label: H4-APP751 cell
definition: The H4 human neuroglioma cell line stably overexpressing human beta-amyloid precursor protein APP751.

label: TTE-1 cell
definition: A Leydig cell line, established from transgenic mice harboring a temperature-sensitive simian virus 40 (tsSV40) large T-antigen gene.

label: trunk kidney
definition: The kidney of the channel catfish is completely separated into the head and trunk kidneys. The head kidney is involved in endocrine and hemopoietic functions and the trunk kidney functions primarily as part of the excretory system.

label: head kidney
definition: The kidney of the channel catfish is completely separated into the head and trunk kidneys. The head kidney is involved in endocrine and hemopoietic functions and the trunk kidney functions primarily as part of the excretory system.

label: sarcomatoid carcinoma cell
definition: Sarcomatoid carcinoma (SARC) of the lung is defined in the most recent World Health Organization classification as "poorly differentiated non-small cell carcinoma that contains a component of sarcoma or sarcoma-like elements. SARC tumors often occur as part of a heterogeneous lung tumor, rather than a tumor consisting of a pure cell type, and most pathologic series classify lung cancer as SARC when at least 10% of the tumor is composed of a sarcomatoid element based on histologic appearance and tissue marker studies.

label: Patu-8988 cell
definition: Human pancreatic cancer cell line.

label: MCF-7/adr cell
definition: A multidrug-resistant (MDR) human breast cancer MCF-7 subline.

label: H4TG cell
definition: This line is a derivative of the H4-II-E-C3 rat hepatoma cell line.

label: fine root
definition: Primary roots usually <2 mm diameter that have the function of water and nutrient uptake. They are often heavily branched and support mycorrhizas. These roots may be short lived, but are replaced by the plant in an ongoing process of root 'turnover'.

label: K-562/R7 cell
definition: Doxorubicin-selected variant of the human myelogenous leukemia cell line K562.

label: KBv200 cell
definition: A multidrug-resistant clone of human oral epidermoid carcinoma KB cells was isolated by stepwise selection on exposure to increasing doses of vincristine. The final clone, KBv200, obtained after ethylmethane sulfonate mutagenesis showed 156-fold higher resistance to vincristine than KB cells. The cells were also cross-resistant to paclitaxel and adriamycin.

label: peltate gland
definition: The monoterpene fraction of the lemon-scented sweet basil (Ocimum basilicum) cv Sweet Dani consists mostly of citral (a mixture of geranial and neral), with lower levels of geraniol and nerol. These compounds are stored in the peltate glands found on the leaf epidermis. Younger leaves, which have a higher density of such glands, also have a higher content of monoterpenes than older leaves.

label: adipose-derived stem cell
definition: Most adult stem cells are lineage-restricted (multipotent) and are generally referred to by their tissue origin e.g. adipose-derived stem cell.

label: CEM-ADR5000 cell
definition: Doxorubicin-resistant human acute T lymphoblastic leukemia cell line CEM/ADR5000.

label: bulbil
definition: A small bulb that develops from an aerial bud. Bulbils are easily detached and function as a means of vegetative propagation. They may form from lateral buds, as in the lesser celandine (Ranunculus ficaria), or develop in place of flowers, as in many species of Allium. Certain forms of apomixis give rise to bulbils, as seen in the lesser bulbous saxifrage (Saxifraga cernua). The term is also applied to various outgrowths formed by lower plants that become detached and develop into new plants. For example, the fern Asplenium bulbiferum produces bulbils on the upper surface of its fronds and Lycopodium selago has bulbils in the axils of the uppermost leaves.

label: Ca9-22 cell
definition: Human gingival carcinoma cell line.

label: cerebral artery
definition: Any of the arteries supplying blood to the cerebral cortex.

label: middle cerebral artery
definition: The middle cerebral artery (MCA) is one of the three major paired arteries that supplies blood to the cerebrum.

label: left middle cerebral artery
definition: The left and right middle cerebral arteries rise from trifurcations of the internal carotid arteries and thus are connected to the anterior cerebral arteries and the posterior communicating arteries, which connect to the posterior cerebral arteries.

label: right middle cerebral artery
definition: The left and right middle cerebral arteries rise from trifurcations of the internal carotid arteries and thus are connected to the anterior cerebral arteries and the posterior communicating arteries, which connect to the posterior cerebral arteries.

label: syntrophic cell culture
definition: A biological relationship in which microorganisms of two different species or strains are mutually dependent on one another for nutritional requirements.

label: choriodecidua
definition: A fetal membrane.

label: cervical intraepithelial neoplasia cell
definition: Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) is the potentially premalignant transformation and abnormal growth (dysplasia) of squamous cells on the surface of the cervix. CIN is not cancer, and is usually curable. Most cases of CIN remain stable, or are eliminated by the host's immune system without intervention. However a small percentage of cases progress to become cervical cancer, usually cervical squamous cell carcinoma (SCC), if left untreated.

label: circular smooth muscle
definition: The inner layer of the muscular coat.

label: longitudinal smooth muscle
definition: The outer layer of the muscular coat.

label: KB-C2 cell
definition: Human epidermoid carcinoma cell line. KB cells were subcloned twice; a singly recloned line, KB-3-1, was used as the parental cell line. Multidrug-resistant KB-C2 cells that overexpress P-gp were originally isolated from KB-3- 1 cells exposed to increasing concentrations of colchicine, and maintained in medium containing 2 ug/ml of colchicine.

label: keratocyst
definition: Cysts found in the jaws and arising from epithelium involved in tooth formation. They include follicular cysts (e.g., primordial cyst, dentigerous cyst, multilocular cyst), lateral periodontal cysts, and radicular cysts. They may become keratinized (odontogenic keratocysts). Follicular cysts may give rise to ameloblastomas and, in rare cases, undergo malignant transformation.

label: LNGK-9 PCa cell
definition: Human prostate cancer cell line.

label: MC57 cell
definition: C57BL/6-derived methylcholantrene-induced fibrosarcoma cell line.

label: osteophyte
definition: A small, abnormal bony outgrowth.

label: PC-3M cell
definition: Human prostate cancer cell line.

label: PC-3M-LN4 cell
definition: PC-3M cells were injected into the prostates of athymic mice. Tumors from the prostate or lymph nodes were harvested and cells were reinjected into the prostate. This cycle was repeated three to five times to yield cell line PC-3M-LN4.

label: PC-3M-Pro4 cell
definition: PC-3M cells were injected into the prostates of athymic mice. Tumors from the prostate or lymph nodes were harvested, and cells were reinjected into the prostate. This cycle was repeated three to five times to yield cell line PC-3M-Pro4.

label: Drosophila D17 cell
definition: D17 cells were originally isolated from cultures of dissected imaginal discs29 of Drosophila melanogaster. Despite their epithelial origin, D17 cells exhibit a gene-expression profile that is consistent with that of Drosophila haemocytes. Similarly to haemocytes, D17 cells spontaneously polarize in culture, assemble an exaggerated leading edge and exhibit robust cell motility.

label: hFOB 1.19 cell
definition: Human fetal osteoblast cell line.

label: CHO-CUR3 cell
definition: CHO cells over-expressing hamster Menkes protein (MNK) due to gene amplification.

label: medial pterygoid muscle
definition: A thick, quadrilateral muscle of mastication. The mandibular branch of the fifth cranial nerve, the trigeminal nerve, innervates the medial pterygoid muscle.

label: XC cell
definition: Rat XC sarcoma cell line, derived from a Rous sarcoma virus-induced Wistar strain rat tumor. XC forms syncytia when cultured in the presence of murine leukemia virus-producing mouse cells. However, one XC cell culture (designated as XC-v cells), found to produce type C virus particles, fails to form syncytia in the presence of murine leukemia virus-producing mouse cells.

label: YT cell
definition: Human T/NK cell leukemia cell line, established from the pericardial fluid of a 15-year-old man with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) at relapse (with accompanying thymoma) in 1983.

label: XC-v cell
definition: Rat XC sarcoma cell line, derived from a Rous sarcoma virus-induced Wistar strain rat tumor. XC forms syncytia when cultured in the presence of murine leukemia virus-producing mouse cells. However, one XC cell culture (designated as XC-v cells), found to produce type C virus particles, fails to form syncytia in the presence of murine leukemia virus-producing mouse cells.

label: stem juice
definition: The stem juice of Musa paradisiaca L. is used in traditional medical practice in Ghana to arrest bleeding from wound. The outer green part of the stem was peeled off and its white inner portion was cut into small pieces (500g). The pieces were crushed mechanically and the juice about 300mL was extracted.

label: T-REx 293 cell
definition: Human embryonic kidney cell line stably expressing the tetracycline (Tet) repressor.

label: pharyngeal epithelium
definition: Epithelium lining the pharynx consisting largely of simple columnar epithelium with a short segment (1mm) of stratified squamous epithelium on the ventral side.

label: MSK-Leuk1 cell
definition: Oral keratinocyte cell line spontaneously derived from an oral leukoplakia lesion that exhibits an immortalized but non-tumorigenic phenotype.

label: MLE-15 cell
definition: Murine lung epithelial cell line.

label: NCI-H1650 cell
definition: Human lung bronchoalveolar carcinoma cell line, tumor stage 3B, derived from pleural effusion.

label: culture condition:CD19+ cell
definition: B-lymphocyte antigen CD19 also known as CD19 (Cluster of Differentiation 19), is a protein that in humans is encoded by the CD19 gene. CD19 is expressed on follicular dendritic cells and B cells. In fact, it is present on B cells from earliest recognizable B-lineage cells during development to B-cell blasts but is lost on maturation to plasma cells.

label: culture condition:CD31+ cell
definition: CD-31 is normally found on endothelial cells, platelets, macrophages and Kupffer cells, granulocytes, T / NK cells, lymphocytes, megakaryocytes, osteoclasts, neutrophils. CD-31 is also expressed in certain tumors, including epithelioid hemangioendothelioma, epithelioid sarcoma-like hemangioendothelioma, other vascular tumors, histiocytic malignancies, and plasmacytomas. It is rarely found in some sarcomas and carcinomas.

label: culture condition:CD103+ cell
definition: CD103 is expressed widely on intraepithelial lymphocyte (IEL) T cells and on some peripheral regulatory T cells (Tregs). It has also been reported on lamina propria T cells. A subset of dendritic cells in the gut mucosa and in mesenteric lymph nodes also expresses this marker and is known as CD103 dendritic cells.

label: M-07E cell
definition: A subline of the M-07 human megakaryoblastic leukemia cell line.

label: M-07 cell
definition: Human megakaryoblastic leukemia cell line.

label: CNE-2 cell
definition: Human nasopharyngeal carcinoma cell line.

label: ink sac
definition: With the exception of nocturnal and very deep water cephalopods, all coeloids which dwell in light conditions have an ink sac, which can be used to expel a cloud of dark ink to confuse predators. This sac is a muscular bag which originated as an extension of the hind gut. It lies beneath the gut and opens into the anus, into which its contents - almost pure melanin - can be squirted.

label: 36B-10 cell
definition: Rat glioma cell line.

label: CHP-100 cell
definition: Human neuroblastoma cell line.

label: CHP-126 cell
definition: Human neuroblastoma cell line.

label: RPMI-1788 cell
definition: Human B-lymphocyte cell line.

label: W001C cell
definition: Wild carrot cell culture line of Daucus carota, Queen Anne`s lace.

label: oropharynx
definition: The area of the throat that is at the back of the mouth. The oropharynx is in contrast to the nasopharynx, the part of the throat that lies behind the nose.

label: oropharyngeal cancer cell
definition: About 90% of oropharyngeal neoplasms are squamous cell carcinoma. Most patients complain of sore throat, otalgia or dysphagia; more advanced, invasive tumours may cause severe pain and trismus.

label: MGL-8 cell
definition: B cell lymphoblast cell line, derived from a normal individual.

label: NEF cell
definition: NEF cells are NIH 3T3 fibroblasts devoid of endogenous EGF-R, transfected with the human EGF-R cDNA.

label: HER 14 cell
definition: HER 14 cells are NIH 3T3 fibroblasts devoid of endogenous EGF-R, transfected with the human EGF-R cDNA.

label: mucoepidermoid carcinoma cell
definition: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma (MEC) is the most common primary salivary gland-type tumour of the lung. It arises from the excretory ducts of the bronchial mucosa.

label: nonparenchymal liver cell
definition: Hepatocytes may constitute 60 to 80 % of the mass of the liver tissue. The remaining tissue is made up of non-parenchymal cells such as sinusoidal endothelial cells, hepatic stellate cells, Kupffer cells and blood cells.

label: cirrhosis disease specific cell type
definition: Widespread disruption of normal liver structure by fibrosis and the formation of regenerative nodules that is caused by any of various chronic progressive conditions affecting the liver as long-term alcohol abuse or hepatitis.

label: 293-F FreeStyle cell
definition: FreeStyle 293-F cell line is derived from the 293 cell line and is intended for use with the FreeStyle MAX 293 Expression System or FreeStyle 293 Expression System.

label: neuropil
definition: Neuropil is a broad term defined as any area in the nervous system composed of mostly unmyelinated axons, dendrites and glial cell processes that forms a synaptically dense region containing a relatively low number of cell bodies. The most prevalent anatomical region of neuropil is the brain which, although not completely composed of neuropil, does have the largest and highest synaptically-concentrated areas of neuropil in the body. White matter, which is mostly composed of axons and glial cells, is generally not considered to be a part of the neuropil.

label: antennal lobe
definition: The antennal lobe is the deutocerebral neuropil of insect which receives the input from the olfactory sensory neurons on the antenna. Functionally, it shares some similarities with the olfactory bulb in vertebrates.

label: HAoAF cell
definition: Human aortic adventitial fibroblast cell line, isolated from human aortic adventitial tissue.

label: anterior hypodermis
definition: Three concentric rings of hypodermal cells (hyp 1, hyp 2 and hyp 3) constitute the hypodermis of the extreme anterior of the worms head.

label: radical leaf
definition: Radical leaves arise from the root or its crown.

label: adventitious root
definition: A root growing from a location other than the underground, descending portion of the axis of a plant, as from a stem or leaf.

label: adventitious root culture
definition: Leaf and stem explants cultured on MS (Murashige and Skoog) medium supplemented with various auxins.

label: HPK1A-ras cell
definition: Malignant human keratinocyte cell line.

label: HPK1A cell
definition: Established human keratinocyte cell line.

label: CAG cell
definition: CAG cell line; established from a bone marrow aspirate of a patient with myeloma.

label: cestode
definition: Any of a class (Cestoda) of bilaterally symmetrical flatworms parasitic especially in the intestines of vertebrates.

label: Caco-2/15 cell
definition: Human colon carcinoma cell line.

label: intercostal muscle
definition: Intercostal muscles are several groups of muscles that run between the ribs, and help form and move the chest wall. The intercostal muscles are mainly involved in the mechanical aspect of breathing. These muscles help expand and shrink the size of the chest cavity when you breathe.

label: WEHI-3B cell
definition: A macrophage-like myelomonocytic leukemia cell line established from inbred BALB/c mice.

label: TS-20 cell
definition: Ts20 is a temperature-sensitive mutant cell line derived from BALB/3T3 cells that is blocked at a step in DNA synthesis involving chain elongation.

label: UML-49 cell
definition: Human normal lymphoblastoid cell line.

label: NPD-2 cell
definition: Niemann-Pick type A dermal fibroblast cell line.

label: 13-90 cell
definition: Bloodstream form trypanosome cell line 13-90.

label: 2102Ep cell
definition: Human embryonal carcinoma line.

label: CL-48 cell
definition: Normal human fetal liver cell line.

label: Col-2 cell
definition: Cultured human colon cancer cell line.

label: TE 353.Sk cell
definition: Skin normal fibroblast cell line.

label: NCI-H1155 cell
definition: Human non-small cell lung cancer cell line; derived from a lymph node metastasis obtained from a patient prior to therapy.

label: NCI-H2347 cell
definition: Human lung adenocarcinoma; non-small cell lung cancer cell line.

label: NCI-H647 cell
definition: Human non-small cell lung adenosquamous carcinoma cell line, established from a 56 years old caucasian male.

label: HCC-38 cell
definition: Human mammary gland primary ductal carcinoma cell line.

label: KBH5.0 cell
definition: This cell line is derived from KB-3-1 by stepwise selection against Hoechst 33342.

label: MEG-01S cell
definition: Suspension culture adapted subline of MEG-01. Chronic megakaryoblastic leukemia cell line.

label: MUM-2B cell
definition: Highly invasive human uveal melanoma line.

label: MUM-2C cell
definition: Human uveal melanoma line.

label: NPrEC cell
definition: An immortalized primary normal human prostate epithelial cell line.

label: GI-102 cell
definition: Undifferentiated human ovarian carcinoma cell line.

label: AS-8 cell
definition: Transgenic tobacco cell line lacking alternative oxidase AOX .

label: corn ear
definition: The ears are female inflorescences, tightly covered over by several layers of leaves, and so closed-in by them to the stem that they do not show themselves easily until the emergence of the pale yellow silks from the leaf whorl at the end of the ear, e.g. by Zea mays.

label: UAMS-32 cell
definition: Murine stromal osteoblastic cell line.

label: A-716 cell
definition: Human non-small cell lung cancer cell line.

label: mTOP2beta-4 cell
