definition: A nonepithelial cell, especially one derived from a macrophage, having characteristics resembling those of an epithelial cell, often found in granulomas associated with tuberculosis.

label: Langhans giant cell
definition: Langhans giant cells are large cells found in granulomatous conditions. They are formed by the fusion of epithelioid cells (macrophages), and contain nuclei arranged in a horseshoe-shaped pattern in the cell periphery. Although traditionally their presence was associated with tuberculosis, they are not specific for tuberculosis or even for mycobacterial disease. In fact, they are found in nearly every form of granulomatous disease, regardless of etiology.

label: peritubular contractile cell
definition: Any of various flattened cells that surround seminiferous tubules.

label: periodontal ligament cell
definition: Periodontal ligament cells are believed to play an important role in periodontal regeneration. That is, they may differentiate into specific cells which make cementum, bone, and attachment apparatus.

label: outer nuclear layer
definition: The outer nuclear layer is one of the layers of the vertebrate retina, the light-detecting portion of the eye. Like the inner nuclear layer, the outer nuclear layer contains several strata of oval nuclear bodies, they are of two kinds, rod and cone granules, so named on account of their being respectively connected with the rods and cones of the next layer.

label: paracentral lobule
definition: The term paracentral lobule refers to the junction of the precentral gyrus and postcentral gyrus on the medial surface of the cerebral cortex. It lies across the boundary between the frontal lobe and the parietal lobe.

label: anterior paracentral gyrus
definition: The anterior portion of the paracentral lobule, the medial continuation of the primary somatomotor cortex (precentral gyrus) in which the thigh, leg, and foot are represented.

label: posterior paracentral gyrus
definition: The posterior part of the paracentral lobule; the medial continuation of the primary somatosensory cortex (postcentral gyrus) in which sensory input from the thigh, leg, and foot are represented.

label: pulmonary neuroendocrine tumor cell
definition: Neuroendocrine tumors (NETs) are neoplasms that arise from cells of the endocrine (hormonal) and nervous systems. Many are benign, while some are malignant. They most commonly occur in the intestine, where they are often called carcinoid tumors, but they are also found in the lung and the rest of the body.

label: precerebellar system
definition: The precerebellar system provides the principal input to the cerebellum and is essential for coordinated motor activity. This ventral brainstem system in the mouse derives from dorsally located rhombic neuroepithelium.

label: gamma delta T-lymphocyte
definition: Gamma delta T cells are a subset of T cells defined by the genetic composition of their T Cell Receptor (TCR). All T cells are derived from common progenitor thymocytes, and while the majority of T cells express TCR chain heterodimers encoded by the alpha and beta gene loci, gamma delta T cells express TCR chains encoded by the gamma and delta gene loci.

label: ventricular aneurysm disease specific cell type
definition: An aneurysm is the outward swelling, or ballooning, of a blood vessel at a weak spot in the wall of the blood vessel. In the case of ventricular aneurysm, the aneurysm occurs in the wall of the heart at the spot where the myocardial infarction occurred. A scar usually forms in the area of the dead muscle tissue, and may eventually calcify. Ventricular aneurysms generally do not rupture. The left ventricle is involved in most cases of ventricular aneurysm.

label: B16-BL6T cell
definition: Highly metastatic murine melanoma overexpressing PKC delta BL6 (BL6T) and wild type (BL6) cell line.

label: BL-6 cell
definition: Highly metastatic murine melanoma overexpressing PKC delta BL6 (BL6T) and wild type (BL6) cell line.

label: BMC-2 cell
definition: Mouse macrophage cell line.

label: BMA cell
definition: Mouse macrophage cell line.

label: KM-20C cell
definition: Human primary colon cancer cell line.

label: Asp-86 cell
definition: Cell line of Asparagus offcinalis L..

label: Sly-1 cell
definition: Cell line of Lycopersicon esculentum Mill..

label: subpharyngeal region
definition: Region beneath the pharynx.

label: cladode
definition: A flattened organ arising from the stem of a plant. These often replace the leaves in photosynthetic function, as leaves in such plants (for example asparagus, butchers broom) are typically reduced to scales.

label: CCE-24 cell
definition: Mouse embryonic stem cell line.

label: Hep-G2/2.15 cell
definition: HepG2.2.15 cells are derived from the human hepatoblastoma cell line HepG2 and are characterized by having stable HBV expression and replication in the culture system.

label: K3OHD cell
definition: Suspension-cultured Digitalis lanata cells.

label: NE-4C cell
definition: The neuroepithelial cell line was established from the cerebral vesicles of 9-day-old mouse embryos lacking the functional p53 genes.

label: NE-GFP-4C cell
definition: The neuroepithelial cell line NE-GFP-4C was established from the cerebral vesicles of 9-day-old mouse embryos lacking the functional p53 genes.

label: osteoarticular cell
definition: Cell pertaining to or affecting bones and joints.

label: parametrium
definition: The connective tissue and fat adjacent to the uterus.

label: parametrial fat pad
definition: The fat adjacent to the uterus.

label: satellite glial cell
definition: Satellite glial cells are the principle glial cells found in the peripheral nervous system, specifically in sensory, sympathetic, and parasympathetic ganglia. They compose the thin cellular sheaths that surround the individual neurons in these ganglia.

label: sensory ganglion
definition: The ganglion on the roots of the cranial nerves, containing the cell bodies of sensory neurons; The spinal ganglion.

label: G3/F11 cell
definition: Mouse hybridoma cell line containing the human aspartyl (asparaginyl) beta-hydroxylase.

label: sympodium
definition: The main axis of growth in the grapevine and similar plants: a lateral branch that arises from just behind the apex of the main stem, which ceases to grow, and continues growing in the same direction as the main stem.

label: monopodium
definition: A main axis of a plant, such as the trunk of a spruce, that maintains a single line of growth, giving off lateral branches.

label: TIG-7 cell
definition: Cell line TIG-7 derived from human male fetal lung.

label: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis disease specific cell type
definition: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a chronic interstitial lung disease of unknown etiology characterized by an accumulation of extracellular matrix, resulting in impaired pulmonary function.

label: LF1 cell
definition: Primary myofibroblast cell culture isolated from an individual patient with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

label: LF2 cell
definition: Primary myofibroblast cell culture isolated from an individual patient with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

label: aortic adventitial fibroblast
definition: Human Aortic Adventitial Fibroblasts (HAoAF). Primary human aortic adventitial fibroblasts (HAoAF) are isolated from human aortic adventitial tissue.

label: awn
definition: Any of the bristles growing from the spikelets of certain grasses, including cereals.

label: nerve ring
definition: A ring of nervous tissue, especially a ring of concentrated nervous tissue about the pharynx of various invertebrate animals.

label: Th17 cell
definition: A subset of T helper cells producing interleukin 17. They are developmentally distinct from Th1 and Th2 cells. They create inflammation and tissue injury in autoimmune disease such as multiple sclerosis (which was previously thought to be caused by Th1 cells), psoriasis, autoimmune uveitis, juvenile diabetes, rheumatoid arthritis, and Crohns disease.

label: Z-12 cell
definition: Endometriotic epithelial cell line.

label: adrenal cortex steroidogenic cell
definition: A steroidogenic cell is involved in the formation of steroids, as by the adrenal cortex, testes, and ovaries.

label: testis steroidogenic cell
definition: A steroidogenic cell is involved in the formation of steroids, as by the adrenal cortex, testes, and ovaries.

label: ovarian steroidogenic cell
definition: A steroidogenic cell is involved in the formation of steroids, as by the adrenal cortex, testes, and ovaries.

label: corolla tube
definition: The tubular part of the corolla.

label: buccal mass
definition: The mouthparts in mollusks other than bivalves and the muscles by which they are operated and with which they generally form a more or less compact mass.

label: buccal muscle
definition: The muscle of the buccal mass.

label: COGA-1A cell
definition: A moderately differentiated human colon cancer cell line.

label: COGA-13 cell
definition: Human colon cancer cell line.

label: Caco-2/AQ cell
definition: A differentiated human colon cancer cell line.

label: NCI-H889 cell
definition: Human small cell lung cancer cell line, established from a 69 years old caucasian female, derived from the lymph node, stage E carcinoma.

label: DMS-53 cell
definition: Human small cell lung cancer cell line, established from a 54 years old caucasian male.

label: NCI-H295A cell
definition: NCI-H295A cells are an adherent subline of human adrenocortical carcinoma NCI-H295 cells that express all adrenal steroidogenic enzymes in a physiologically appropriate, hormonal responsive fashion.

label: C-20/A4 cell
definition: Human chondrocyte cell line, derived from juvenile costal chondrocytes by immortalization with origin-defective simian virus 40 large T antigen.

label: KGN cell
definition: A steroidogenic human ovarian granulosa-like tumor cell line, from a patient with invasive ovarian granulosa cell carcinoma.

label: LNCaP-C4-2 cell
definition: LNCaP and its derivative cell lines, which include C4-2 and the related C4-2B and CL1, are used as models of prostate cancer.

label: LNCaP-CL1 cell
definition: LNCaP and its derivative cell lines, which include C4-2 and the related C4-2B and CL1, are used as models of prostate cancer.

label: SW-60 cell
definition: Human colorectal tumor cell line.

label: BNL-HCC cell
definition: Mouse hepatoma cell line derived from the normal BALB/c embryonic liver cell line BNL CL2.

label: vaginal mucosa
definition: The mucosal layer of the vagina.

label: BmN4-SID1 cell
definition: Silkworm ovary-derived cell line, ectopically expressing Caenorhabditis elegans transmembrane protein SID-1, which functions as a channel for the transport of dsRNA.

label: cervicovaginal cell
definition: Cell of or relating to the uterine cervix and the vagina.

label: small luteal cell
definition: Small luteal cells are derived from follicular theca cells.

label: large luteal cell
definition: Large luteal cells are derived from follicular granulosa cells.

label: storage root
definition: A modified root for storage of food or water, such as carrots and beets.

label: 2B4-T cell
definition: Mouse 2B4 T hybridoma cell line.

label: VK-2/E6E7 cell
definition: The vaginal epithelial cell line VK-2/E6E7 was derived from epithelial cells of vaginal mucosal tissue from a 32-years-old premenopausal woman undergoing anterior-posterior repair and was demonstrated to have structural and functional properties similar to those of their parental primary cells.

label: MYP-30 cell
definition: A pig endothelial cell line.

label: shoot apical meristem
definition: The tissue that produces all aerial parts of the plant, which include the stem as well as lateral structures, such as leaves and flowers.

label: atrioventricular node
definition: A small mass of specialized cardiac muscle fibers, located in the wall of the right atrium of the heart, that receives heartbeat impulses from the sinoatrial node and directs them to the walls of the ventricles.

label: BmN4 cell
definition: Bombyx mori ovary-derived cultured cell line.

label: RCC-4 cell
definition: Renal cell carcinoma cell line stably transfected with an empty expression vector, pcDNA3, conferring neomycin resistance.

label: column
definition: A columnlike structure, especially one formed by the union of a stamen and the style in an orchid flower, or one formed by the united staminal filaments in flowers such as those of the hibiscus or mallow.

label: lateral nerve cord
definition: A cord of nerve tissue that is formed by union of the superior and middle trunks of the brachial plexus and that forms one of the two roots of the median nerve.

label: stem leaf
definition: A leaf growing from the stem of a plant, as contrasted with a basal or radical leaf.

label: sensorimotor area
definition: The precentral and postcentral gyri of the cerebral cortex.

label: amoeboid microglia
definition: This form of microglial cell is found mainly within the perinatal white matter areas in the corpus callosum known as the Fountains of Microglia. This shape allows the microglial free movement throughout the neural tissue, which allows it to fulfill its role as a scavenger cell. Amoeboid microglia are able to phagocytose debris, but do not fulfill the same antigen-presenting and inflammatory roles as activated microglia. Amoeboid microglia are especially prevalent during the development and rewiring of the brain, when there are large amounts of extracellular debris and apoptotic cells to remove.

label: atrichoblast cell
definition: A root epidermal cell that will not give rise to a root hair.

label: trichoblast cell
definition: A root epidermal cell that will give rise to a root hair.

label: milk gland
definition: Larval nutrition is provided via a modified accessory gland, a milk gland, that empties into the uterus. The milk gland is connected to the dorsal side of the uterus and expands throughout the abdominal cavity of the fly as bifurcating tubules intertwining with fat body tissue. The lumen of the milk gland is surrounded by secretory and epithelial cells.

label: headfoot muscle
definition: The head-foot is the part you see most easily in slugs and snails. It is mostly a muscular organ covered in cilia and rich in mucous cells, which the mollusc uses to move around, it normally tapers to a tail at one end and has a head incorporated in the front. The head includes a mouth, eyes and tentacles, the last two may be much reduced or even absent. In those species with shells the head-foot can be drawn into the shell.

label: HEY-1B cell
definition: Human highly-invasive ovarian cancer cell line.

label: HMEEC cell
definition: Human middle ear epithelial cell line.

label: IGR-3 cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: M5 melanoma cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: Mel007 cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: Mel-AT cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: Mel-CV cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: Mel-FH cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: Mel-RM cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: Me4405 cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: MM200 cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: Mel-JD cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: Mel-RMU cell
definition: Human malignant melanoma cell line.

label: MOLM-14 cell
definition: Human acute myeloid leukemia cell line. Sister cell line of MOLM-13 cell.

label: QGY-7703 cell
definition: Human hepatocellular carcinoma cell line.

label: retrocerebral organ
definition: A small glandular organ, attached to the epidermis above and behind the brain, comprised of the retrocerebral sac and the subcerebral glands.

label: cerebral organ
definition: In Nemertina one of paired ciliated tubes associated with the dorsal ganglion and opening to the exterior, that function as chemical sense organs. In Sipuncula the anterior margin of the cerebral ganglion made up of high columnar epithelium, probably not sensory in function.

label: CG-4 cell
definition: A permanent cell line of rat central nervous system glial precursors from primary cultures of bipotential oligodendrocyte-type 2-astrocyte (O-2A) progenitor cells. The CG-4 cells have a normal karyotype and display the properties of normal O-2A cells.

label: Lunet-Con1 cell
definition: Lunet-Con1 cell line was derived from Lunet cell line.

label: UOK-262 cell
definition: Fumarate hydratase deficient hereditary leiomyomatosis renal cell carcinoma, derived from a patient having aggressive HLRCC-associated recurring kidney cancer.

label: gynophore
definition: A gynophore is the stalk of certain flowers which supports the gynoecium elevating it above the branching points of other floral parts.

label: chemoreceptor cell
definition: A sensory nerve cell or sense organ, as of smell or taste, that responds to chemical stimuli.

label: Hepa-RG cell
definition: Terminally differentiated hepatic cells derived from a human hepatic progenitor cell line that retains many characteristics of primary human hepatocytes.

label: HMVEC cell
definition: Human microvascular endothelial cell line.

label: transfer cell
definition: A type of plant cell specialized for the short-distance high-volume transport of materials. Transfer cells have numerous knobs and ridges on the inner surface of the primary cell wall. These greatly increase the surface area of the plasma membrane, which follows the contours of the protuberances. The expanded plasma membrane can accommodate a large number of transport proteins, which are responsible for transporting materials in or out of the cell. Transfer cells are found mainly in salt-secreting glands and in regions where photosynthate (sugar) is loaded or unloaded into sieve elements of phloem.

label: plant stem cell
definition: Plant stem cells are innately undifferentiated cells located in the meristems of plant. Plant stem cells serve as the origin of plant vitality, as they maintain themselves while providing a steady supply of precursor cells to form differentiated tissues and organs in plants. Two distinct areas of stem cells are recognised: the apical meristem and the lateral meristem.

label: lateral meristem
definition: A meristem in vascular plants, such as the cambium, in which secondary growth occurs.

label: mature stage
definition: The post-flowering stage of a plant.

label: vegetative stage
definition: The pre-flowering stage of a plant.

label: SHI-1 cell
definition: Human acute myelocytic leukemia cell line, established in 2002 from the bone marrow of a 37-year-old male with relapsed acute monocytic leukemia (AML-M5b).

label: gynostemium
definition: The column formed by the union of androecium and gynoecium, as in an orchid.

label: IGR-37 cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line, established from the lymph node metastasis (groin) of a 26-year-old man with malignant melanoma.

label: AC2M2 cell
definition: Highly metastatic murine mammary carcinoma cell line.

label: 16-HBE cell
definition: An immortalized but nontransformed cell line, derived from ciliated human bronchial epithelial cells that line the airway of the lung.

label: dentate granule cell
definition: The principal cell type of the dentate gyrus is the dentate granule cell. The granule cells are tightly packed in the granular cell layer of the dentate gyrus.

label: C8161.9 cell
definition: Human highly metastatic melanoma cell line.

label: CHO-13-5-1 cell
definition: LDL receptor-related protein 1-deficient mutant CHO cell line.

label: CHO-A7 cell
definition: Arginase-deficient CHO cell variant.

label: choroid plexus papilloma cell
definition: Choroid plexus papillomas are an uncommon, benign neuroepithelial intraventricular tumour which can occur in both the paediatric and adult population.

label: decidual stromal cell
definition: Decidual stromal cells are the main cellular component of the human decidua.

label: EC-9706 cell
definition: Human esophageal carcinoma cell line.

label: Eca-109 cell
definition: Human esophageal squamous carcinoma cell line.

label: epitheliocyte
definition: An in vitro tissue culture epithelial cell.

label: 2fTGH cell
definition: The human sarcoma cell line HT 1080 was transfected with a vector encoding the selectable marker guanine phosphoribosyltransferase regulated by alpha interferon to create the 2fTGH cell line, enabling the selection of mutations in genes encoding components of the interferon signalling pathway.

label: A2780/CP cell
definition: Cisplatin-resistant variant of the human ovarian carcinoma cell line A2780.

label: buccal gland
definition: Any of the small racemose mucous glands in the mucous membrane lining the cheeks.

label: epididymal epithelium
definition: In the epididymal epithelium, the tall columnar cells and shorter basal cells give the appearance of two rows of nuclei. However, both types of cells together really form a single layer with every cell sitting on the basement membrane. Hence this epithelium is pseudostratified. The epididymal epithelium is supported by loose connective tissue.

label: HO-1-N-1 cell
definition: Human squamous carcinoma cell line of the buccal mucosa.

label: HO-8910PM
definition: Highly metastatic human ovarian cancer cell line.

label: HuH-1 cell
definition: Human hepatoma cell line, established from a liver tumor of a 53-year-old japanese male.

label: IPC-298 cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line, established from the primary tumor (right cervical) of a 64-year-old woman with cutaneous melanoma.

label: KBM-7 cell
definition: Human chronic myeloid leukemia cell line.

label: LN-71 cell
definition: Human central nervous system glioma cell line.

label: midgut diverticulum
definition: The midgut of arachnids and crustaceans is a simple, often relatively short tube, bit it gives rise to large tubular or branched midgut diverticula.

label: myeloblastoma cell
definition: A focal malignant tumor composed of myeloblasts or early myeloid precursors occurring outside the bone marrow.

label: NCI-H1838 cell
definition: Human adenocarcinoma non-small cell lung cancer cell line.

label: WM-902B cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: THLE-5b cell
definition: Nonmalignant human hepatocyte cell line.

label: tenocyte
definition: An elongated fibroblast cell found in tendons.

label: syncytium
definition: A multinucleate mass of protoplasm produced by the merging of cells.

label: embryonic syncytium
definition: Another correct and well-established use of the word syncytium is found in animal embryology to refer to the coenocytic blastoderm embryos of invertebrates, such as Drosophila melanogaster.

label: SNU-1 cell
definition: Human gastric carcinoma cell line, established from a 44 years old asian male.

label: skeletal muscle satellite cell
definition: An elongated, spindle-shaped, cell that is located between the basal lamina and the plasmalemma of a muscle fiber. These cells are mostly quiescent, but upon activation they divide to produce cells that generate new muscle fibers.

label: SH-EP1 cell
definition: Human neuroblastoma cell line, established from brain bone marrow tissue from a 4 years old caucasian white with neuroblastoma.

label: root band
definition: The node consists of a growth ring or intercalary meristem, the root band (containing root primordia) and a bud above the leaf scar where the leaf sheath attaches, which delimits the node from the internode below.

label: promyelocyte
definition: Granulocyte precursor, developing from the myeloblast and developing into the myelocyte.

label: enamel knot
definition: In tooth development, the enamel knot is a localization of cells on an enamel organ that appear thickened in the center of the inner enamel epithelium.

label: primary enamel knot
definition: The primary enamel knot forms at the tip of the bud during the cap stage of tooth development. This primary enamel knot is removed by apoptosis.

label: secondary enamel knot
definition: The primary enamel knot forms at the tip of the bud during the cap stage of tooth development. This primary enamel knot is removed by apoptosis. Later, secondary enamel knots appear that regulate the formation of the future cusps of the teeth.

label: osteoma cell
definition: A benign tumor composed of bony tissue, often developing on the skull.

label: PEO-1 cell
definition: Human ovarian adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: PEO-4 cell
definition: Human ovarian adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: PEO-6 cell
definition: Human ovarian adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: corticotroph adenoma cell
definition: A pituitary adenoma made up predominantly of corticotrophs. Excessive corticotropin secretion may cause Cushings disease or Nelsons syndrome.

label: Neu-7 cell
definition: Murine astrocyte cell line.

label: K-562/CP cell
definition: Cisplatin resistant subline of K-562 leukemia cell line.

label: dentate gyrus HICAP cell
definition: The dentate gyrus HICAP cells (Hilar Commissural-Associational pathway related cells) are multipolar or triangular cells in the polymorphic layer with thin, aspiny dendrites that extend both within the hilus and within the molecular layer. The axons of these HICAP cells extend through the granule cell layer and branch profusely in the inner third of the molecular layer.

label: dentate gyrus HIPP cell
definition: The dentate gyrus HIPP cell (Hilar Perforant Path-associated cell) is an interneuron in the hippocampal formation. It is a long-spined multipolar cell that is conspicuous of distribution of copious, long and often branched spines over its cell body and dendrites. The axonal plexus can extend as much as 3.5mm along the septotemporal axis of the dentate gyrus. Since inhibitory interneurons typically have aspiny dendrites and relatively local axonal plexuses, this long spined multipolar/HIPP cell is a very atypical interneuron.

label: dentate gyrus IS-I cell
definition: The interneuron-specific subpopulation of interneurons have axons that preferentially innervate other interneurons. The dentate gyrus IS-I class interneurons are visualized by immunostaining for Calretinin (CR)and establish multiple symmetrical synapses on the dendrites and somata of other CR-positive IS-I cells, Calbindin (CB) containing interneurons, and VIP-positive basket cells, but they do not innervate PV-containing interneurons. The dendrites of dentate gyrus IS I neurons appear in all layers of dentate gyrus and more characteristic feature of these dendrites is that they form long dendrodendritic junctions with each other.

label: dentate gyrus IS-II cell
definition: The Interneuron-Specific subpopulation of interneurons have axons that preferentially innervate other interneurons. The dentate gyrus IS-II class interneurons are visualized by immunostaining for Vasoactive Intestinal Polypeptide (VIP). The dendrites of dentate gyrus IS-II cells are present in all layers of dentate gyrus.

label: flexor tendon
definition: The flexor tendons are strong smooth cords that connect the muscles of the forearm to the bones in the fingers and thumb. There are two to each finger and one for the thumb.

label: GI-LA-N cell
definition: Human neuroblastoma cell line; established from the metastases of a lymph node biopsy of a stage III neuroblastoma after 7 months of chemotherapy.

label: GI-ME-N cell
definition: Human neuroblastoma cell line; established from the metastases of a bone marrow specimen of a stage IV neuroblastoma after 6 months of chemotherapy.

label: HMVEC-dLy cell
definition: Normal human dermal lymphatic microvascular endothelial cell line.

label: immune system
definition: The bodily system that protects the body from foreign substances, cells, and tissues by producing the immune response and that includes especially the thymus, spleen, lymph nodes, special deposits of lymphoid tissue (as in the gastrointestinal tract and bone marrow), macrophages, lymphocytes including the B cells and T cells, and antibodies.

label: cigar leaf
definition: A leaf near the apex of a stem that is still rolled into a cylinder.

label: BEL-7404 cell
definition: Hepatocellular carcinoma cell line.

label: A-375.S2 cell
definition: Skin malignant melanoma cell line. This line was cloned by limiting dilution from the A375 melanoma cell line.

label: A549-CR cell
definition: A549-CR cell line, was established by repeated subculturing of A549 cells with increasing Cisplatin.

label: adrenocortical cell
definition: Cell, pertaining to or arising from the cortex of the adrenal gland.

label: BIN-67 cell
definition: Small cell ovarian carcinoma of the hypercalcemic type, SCCOHT cell line.

label: histaminergic neuron
definition: Histaminergic neurons in mammalian brain are located exclusively in the tuberomamillary nucleus of the posterior hypothalamus and send their axons all over the central nervous system; The cell body of C2 is an identified histaminergic neuron in the cerebral ganglion of Aplysia.

label: CATH.a cell
definition: Mouse brain neuronal cell line; established from cultures of a tumor that arose in the brain of a transgenic mouse; A CNS catecholaminergic cell line; established by targeted oncogenesis in transgenic mice. Cath.a cells express neuronal properties but lack neuronal morphology.

label: CMT-167 cell
definition: Mouse lung carcinoma cell line; established from mouse strain C57BL/lcrf .

label: cochlear hair cell
definition: Sensory cells in the organ of Corti in synaptic contact with sensory as well as efferent fibers of the cochlear auditory nerve; from the apical end of each cell, about 100 stereocilia extend from the surface and make contact with the tectorial membrane. Any of the cilia on the free surface of the auditory cells.

label: hair-cell stereocilium
definition: In the inner ear, stereocilia are the mechanosensing organelles of hair cells, which respond to fluid motion in numerous types of animals for various functions, including hearing and balance. They are about 10 to 50 micrometers in length and share some similar features of microvilli. Stereocilia exist in the auditory and vestibular systems.

label: vestibular hair cell
definition: Vestibular hair cells are in the sensory epithelium of the maculae and cristae of the membranous labyrinth of the internal ear.

label: ctenidium
definition: 1: The gill of a mollusk consisting typically of a respiratory structure that resembles a comb or feather, has a main stem with lateral lamellae, and is developed from the inner side of the mantle. 2:A structure consisting of a row of spines resembling the teeth of a comb on the head or thorax, or both, of certain fleas.

label: Detroit-551 cell
definition: Normal human skin fibroblast cell line; established from a fetus of a Caucasian female.

label: FAA-HTC1 cell
definition: Rat hepatoma cell line.

label: frontoparietal cortex
definition: Relating to both frontal and parietal bones of the cranium.

label: leukodystrophy disease specific cell type
definition: Leukodystrophy is a term for a group of white matter diseases, some familial, characterized by progressive cerebral deterioration usually in early life, and pathologically by primary absence or degeneration of the myelin of the central and peripheral nervous systems with glial reaction; probably related to a defect in lipid metabolism.

label: globoid cell leukodystrophy disease specific cell type
definition: A cell of the lysosomal storage disease beginning in infancy, due to deficiency of beta-galactosidase. Pathologically, there is rapidly progressive cerebral demyelination and large globoid bodies in the white substance.

label: globoid cell
definition: A large cell of mesodermal origin that is found clustered in the intracranial tissues in globoid cell leukodystrophy.

label: plant gall
definition: An abnormal growth of plant tissue caused by an organism, such as an insect, mite, or bacterium, or by a wound.

label: infectious granuloma cell
definition: One due to a specific microorganism, as tubercle bacilli.

label: granuloma cell
definition: An imprecise term applied to 1: any small nodular, delimited aggregation of mononuclear inflammatory cells, or 2: a similar collection of modified macrophages resembling epithelial cells, usually surrounded by a rim of lymphocytes, often with multinucleated giant cells.

label: NCI-H1792 cell
definition: Human lung stage 4 adenocarcinoma cell line; established from a pleural effusion of a 50 years old caucasian male smoker.

label: NCI-H1944 cell
definition: Human stage 3B adenocarcinoma non-small cell lung cancer cell line, established from soft tissue of a 62 years old caucasian female.

label: head and neck cancer cell
definition: Head and neck cancer is cancer that starts in the lip, oral cavity, nasal cavity, paranasal sinuses, pharynx, larynx or parotid glands.

label: HEK-293VnR cell
definition: A HEK293 cell line that stably expresses the alpha v beta 3 integrin, the vitronectin receptor.

label: Hs888Lu cell
definition: Normal human lung fibroblast cell line. The line was derived from normal tissue from a 20 years old male caucasian patient who had osteosarcoma metastatic to the lung.

label: Hunter's organ
definition: The electric eel has three pairs of abdominal organs that produce electricity: the main organ, the Hunter's organ, and the Sach's organ. These organs are made of electrocytes, lined up so a current of ions can flow through them and stacked so each one adds to a potential difference. The Sach's organ is associated with electrolocation. Inside the organ are many muscle-like cells, called electrocytes. Each cell can only produce 0.15 V, though the organ can transmit a signal of nearly 10 V overall in amplitude at around 25 Hz in frequency. These signals are emitted by the main organ; the Hunter's organ can emit signals at rates of several hundred hertz.

label: Sach's organ
definition: The electric eel has three pairs of abdominal organs that produce electricity: the main organ, the Hunter's organ, and the Sach's organ. These organs are made of electrocytes, lined up so a current of ions can flow through them and stacked so each one adds to a potential difference. The Sach's organ is associated with electrolocation. Inside the organ are many muscle-like cells, called electrocytes. Each cell can only produce 0.15 V, though the organ can transmit a signal of nearly 10 V overall in amplitude at around 25 Hz in frequency. These signals are emitted by the main organ; the Hunter's organ can emit signals at rates of several hundred hertz.

definition: Is thought to be a human nasopharyngeal carcinoma cell line. Seems to be the same as CNE-2. Could be generated by fusion of HeLa with an NPC cell line.

label: mHypoE-N43/5 cell
definition: Embryonic mouse hypothalamus cell line.

label: benign prostatic hyperplasia cell
definition: Benign enlargement of the prostate, a noncancerous increase in size of the prostate. BPH involves hyperplasia of prostatic stromal and epithelial cells, resulting in the formation of large, fairly discrete nodules in the transition zone of the prostate. It involves hyperplasia - an increase in the number of cells - rather than hypertrophy - a growth in the size of individual cells.

label: SAEC cell
definition: Primary human small airway epithelial cells, isolated from normal human lung tissue at the distal portion of lung in the 1mm bronchiole area.

label: hPSC cell
definition: Human pluripotent stem cell. Includes human embryonic stem cells and human induced pluripotent stem cells. It can self-renew indefinitely in culture while maintaining the ability to become almost any cell type in the human body.

label: hESC cell
definition: Human embryonic stem cell.

label: hiPSC cell
definition: Human induced pluripotent stem cell.

label: TSCCA cell
definition: Oral squamous cell carcinoma cell line.

label: U-87MG/DDP cell
definition: Cisplatin-resistant U87MG cell line; established by continuing exposure of the parental cells to gradient increasing concentration of the respective drug.

label: uninucleate trophoblast cell
definition: Trophoblast cell having one nucleus.

label: 212LN cell
definition: Head and neck cancer cell line.

label: HS-SY-2 cell
definition: Human synovial sarcoma cell line (HS-SY-II) from pleural effusion with lung metastasis.

label: caudolateral nidopallium
definition: The avian Nidopallium caudolaterale is a multimodal area in the caudal telencephalon that is apparently not homologous to the mammalian prefrontal cortex but serves comparable functions.

label: KEL-FIB cell
definition: Human skin connective tissue normal fibroblast cell line; established from a 35 years old black female.

label: CCD-1113Sk cell
definition: Human skin normal fibroblast cell line; established from a 39 years old black female from normal breast tissue.

label: HCC-1569 cell
definition: Human epithelial breast mammary gland carcinoma cell line; established from a 70 years old black female with TNM stage IV, grade 3, primary metaplastic carcinoma.

label: HeLa-HL3T1 cell
definition: The HeLa derivative HL3T1 is a sensitive indicator cell line for the HIV-1 Tat transactivator protein.

label: hTERT-HPNE cell
definition: Human normal pancreas duct cell line; established from a 52 years old male.

label: LNCaP clone FGC
definition: Human prostate cancer cell line; established from a 50 years old caucasian male; derived from metastatic site: left supraclavicular lymph node.

label: HEKa cell
definition: Normal human primary epidermal keratinocytes.

label: root apical meristem
definition: The collection of cells at the root tip that generate all the tissues of a plant root.

label: S2-028 cell
definition: Human pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: plant protocorm
definition: A tuber structure that develops from the embryos of lycopods (Lycopodiaceae) and orchids (Orchidaceae).

label: insect protocorm
definition: The part of an insect embryo posterior to the protocephalon.

label: activated skeletal muscle satellite cell
definition: A skeletal muscle cell that has become mitotically active - typically following muscle damage.

label: quiescent skeletal muscle satellite cell
definition: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that is mitotically quiescent. These cells are wedge shaped and have a large nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio with few organelles, a small nucleus and condensed interphase chromatin. Satellite cells typically remain in this state until activated following muscle damage.

label: skeletal muscle satellite stem cell
definition: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that divides by stem cell division.  A proportion of this population undergoes symmetric stem cell division, producing two skeletal muscle satellite stem cells. The rest undergo asymmetric stem cell division - retaining their identity while budding off a daughter cell that differentiates into an adult skeletal muscle myoblast.

label: adrenal adenoma cell
definition: A benign tumor of the adrenal cortex.

label: M1 macrophage
definition: Macrophages that encourage inflammation. M1 "killer" macrophages are activated by LPS and IFN-gamma, and secrete high levels of IL-12 and low levels of IL-10.

label: M2 macrophage
definition: Macrophages that decrease inflammation and encourage tissue repair. M2 is the phenotype of resident tissue macrophages, and can be further elevated by IL-4. M2 macrophages produce high levels of IL-10, TGF-beta and low levels of IL-12. Tumor-associated macrophages are mainly of the M2 phenotype, and seem to actively promote tumor growth.

label: fibro-adipogenic progenitor cell
definition: FAPs are tissue-resident mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs). Current literature supports a role for these cells in the homeostasis and repair of multiple tissues suggesting that FAPs may have extensive therapeutic potential in the treatment of numerous diseases.

label: megaspore
definition: A spore in heterosporous plants giving rise to female gametophytes and usually larger than a microspore.

label: MEL-C19 cell
definition: The C19 MEL cell line is a thymidine kinase negative subclone of the 745 murine erythroleukemia cell line.

label: mesenterial filament
definition: A thickened rim or ribbon-like extension running along the free border of a mesentery from the end of the actinopharynx downwards. They aid in the capture and digestion of food materials and may also assist in inhibiting substrate competitors.

label: microsclerotium
definition: A very small sclerotium.

label: middle silk gland
definition: The silk gland contains three compartments according its morphology and function, including the anterior silk gland, middle silk gland, and posterior silk gland. The fibroins and sericins are synthesized in the posterior and middle silk gland, respectively and then stored in the lumen of the silk gland as a concentrated aqueous silk solution.

label: MYCN-2 cell
definition: Human neuroblastoma cell line.

label: villous cytotrophoblast
definition: An undifferentiated cytotrophoblastic stem cell will differentiate into a villous cytotrophoblast, which is what constitutes primary chorionic villi, and will eventually coalesce into villous syncytiotrophoblast.

label: synergid cell
definition: Synergid cells are two specialized cells that lie adjacent to the egg cell in the female gametophyte of angiosperms and play an essential role in pollen tube guidance and function. The term synergid comes from the Greek synergos, which means working together and was reportedly coined by Eduard Strasburger, a famous 19th century botanist who was one of the first to note that these cells somehow assist fertilization of the egg.

label: TU-KATO-III cell
definition: Tumorigenic TU-kato-III cells were derived from the gastric cancer cell line KATO-III.

label: T-98 cell
definition: T98 and T98G are two related cell lines that were derived from a human glioblastoma multiforma tumor. T98G has almost twice as many chromosomes as T98, suggesting that it is a polyploid variant of T98.

label: C3ABR cell
definition: Human lymphoblastoid cell line; established by Epstein-Barr virus transformation from an healthy individual.

label: AT1ABR cell
definition: Human lymphoblastoid cell line; established from A-T (Ataxia telangiectasia) patients by Epstein-Barr virus immortalization.

label: AT25ABR cell
definition: Human lymphoblastoid cell line; established from A-T (Ataxia telangiectasia) patients by Epstein-Barr virus immortalization.

label: adventitious root primordium
definition: Primordium of an adventitious root.

label: spinothalamic tract
definition: The spinothalamic tract is a sensory pathway from the skin to the thalamus. From the ventral posterolateral nucleus in the thalamus, sensory information is relayed upward to the somatosensory cortex of the postcentral gyrus.

label: lateral spinothalamic tract
definition: One of the two main parts of the spinathalamic tract. It transmits pain and temperature.

label: anterior spinothalamic tract
definition: One of the two main parts of the spinathalamic tract. It transmits crude touch and firm pressure.

label: corticospinal tract
definition: The corticospinal tract is a descending tract of the spinal cord which contains bundles of axons which originate in the cerebral cortex and descend to synapse within the brainstem or spinal cord.

label: forespore
definition: A precursor of a spore; specifically: a form preceding the endospore in some bacteria and characterized by diffuse response to chromatin stains.

label: culture condition:GR1+ cell
definition: GR1+ is a granulocytic marker.

label: HNE-1 cell
definition: Human nasopharyngeal carcinoma cell line.

label: HONE-1 cell
definition: Human nasopharyngeal carcinoma cell line.

label: Hs-27 cell
definition: Human foreskin fibroblast cell line, established from a black newborn male.

label: internal capsule
definition: The internal capsule is a white matter structure situated in the inferomedial part of each cerebral hemisphere of the brain.

label: NPC-TW03 cell
definition: Human nasopharyngeal carcinoma cell line.

label: SN4741 cell
definition: Cell line from substantia nigra dopaminergic cells derived from transgenic mouse embryos.

label: Lu-99 cell
definition: Lung giant cell carcinoma cell line derived from human.

label: M4A4 LM3-4 CL16 GFP cell
definition: Human melanocyte melanoma cell line. Recent studies have generated questions about the origin of the parent cell line, MDA-MB-435. Gene expression analysis of the cells produced microarrays in which MDA-MB-435 clustered with cell lines of melanoma origin instead of breast.

label: MHCC-LM3 cell
definition: Human hepatocellular carcinoma cell line.

label: NM2C5 cell
definition: Human melanocyte melanoma cell line. Recent studies have generated questions about the origin of the parent cell line, MDA-MB-435. Additional studies have since corroborated a melanocyte origin of MDA-MB-435, to which ATCC has responded by pursuing its own investigation into the identity of this cell line.

label: NM2C5-GFP cell
definition: Human melanocyte melanoma cell line. Recent studies have generated questions about the origin of the parent cell line, MDA-MB-435. Gene expression analysis of the cells produced microarrays in which MDA-MB-435 clustered with cell lines of melanoma origin instead of breast.

label: culture condition:corn steep liquor-grown cell
definition: Corn steep liquor is a by-product of corn wet-milling.  A viscous concentrate of corn solubles which contains amino acids, vitamins and minerals, it is an important constituent of some growth media.

label: IHH cell
definition: Immortalized human hepatocyte cell line.

label: Flp-In-T-REx cell
definition: T-REx cell derivative with targeted integration of a Flp-In expression vector.

label: plasmablastic lymphoma cell
definition: Plasmablastic lymphoma is a type of large B-cell lymphoma.

label: coral nubbin
definition: Large coral colonies are fragmented into nubbins and attached to a substrate using Gorilla Glue. They are cultivated in open flow seawater tanks.

label: microtome section
definition: A microtome is a tool used to cut extremely thin slices of material, known as sections.

label: nigrostriatal system
definition: System relating to, or joining the corpus striatum and the substantia nigra. Referring to the efferent connection.

label: olivocerebellar fiber system
definition: The olivocerebellar tract are neural fibers which originate at the olivary nucleus and pass out through the hilum and decussate with those from the opposite olive in the raphe nucleus, then as internal arcuate fibers they pass partly through and partly around the opposite olive and enter the inferior peduncle to be distributed to the cerebellar hemisphere of the opposite side from which they arise.

label: root vascular cylinder
definition: In the roots, the vascular tissue is organized within a single central vascular cylinder.

label: rubrospinal tract
definition: Spinal cord motor tract emanating from the red nucleus.

label: olivopontocerebellar fiber
definition: Fiber pertaining to the olive, the middle peduncles and the cerebellar cortex.

label: pontocerebellar fiber
definition: The pontocerebellar fibers are the second order neuron fibers of the corticopontocerebellar tracts that cross to the other side of the pons and run within the middle cerebellar peduncles, from the pons to the contralateral cerebellum.

label: C-2 cell
definition: Histaminergic neuron of Aplysia californica.

label: nucleus preopticus lateralis
definition: A nucleus of nerve cells in the preoptic area of the basal forebrain, ventral to the anterior commissure.

label: nucleus preopticus medialis
definition: A nucleus of nerve cells in the preoptic area of the basal forebrain.

label: nucleus preopticus medianus
definition: A nucleus of nerve cells in the preoptic area of the basal forebrain.

label: nucleus preopticus periventricularis
definition: A nucleus of nerve cells in the preoptic area of the basal forebrain.

label: syncytial embryo sac
definition: A stage of the embryo sac development.

label: testicular somatic cell
definition: Somatic cell of the testis.

label: trichilium
definition: Trichome-covered tissue. Typically, the ventral petiole base of Cecropia leaves has a hairy mat, the trichilia, that produces glycogen-rich Muellerian bodies.

label: inferior temporal gyrus
definition: The inferior-most of the three longitudinal gyri that cover the lateral surface of the temporal lobe.

label: middle temporal gyrus
definition: The middle the three longitudinal gyri that cover the lateral surface of the temporal lobe.

label: superior temporal gyrus
definition: The superior of the three longitudinal gyri that cover the lateral surface of the temporal lobe.

label: temporal gyrus
definition: The superior, the middle, or the inferior temporal gyrus.

label: cardiac tube
definition: The primordial tubular heart in the embryo, before its division into chambers.

label: endocardial heart tube
definition: The two endothelial tubes that meet in the midthoracic region of the embryo and fuse to form the primordial cardiac or heart tube, the primordium of the heart.

label: buffy coat
definition: The buffy coat is the fraction of an anticoagulated blood sample that contains most of the white blood cells and platelets following density gradient centrifugation of the blood.

label: venous blood cell
definition: Blood cell found in the veins. Except in the pulmonary vein venous blood is rich in carbon dioxide and poor in oxygen.

label: arterial blood cell
definition: Blood cell found in arteries. Except for the pulmonary artery the arterial blood is rich in oxygen.

label: mouth floor
definition: That area of the oral cavity beneath the tongue.

label: buffy coat cell
definition: The buffy coat is the fraction of an anticoagulated blood sample that contains most of the white blood cells and platelets following density gradient centrifugation of the blood.

label: air pouch cell
definition: An air pouch is produced by subcutaneous injection of sterile air into the back of a mouse or rat. With the air pouch model large volumes of inflammatory exudates can be collected with relative ease. Injection of carrageenan solution or other inflammatory irritant (i.e. LPS, bradykinin), into the air pouch causes an inflammatory reaction.

label: venous blood
definition: Blood found in the veins. Except in the pulmonary vein venous blood is rich in carbon dioxide and poor in oxygen.

label: arterial blood
definition: Blood found in arteries. Except for the pulmonary artery the arterial blood is rich in oxygen.

label: protoperithecium
definition: A primordium that when fertilized develops into a perithecium.

label: cybrid cell
definition: A cell that has nuclear DNA from one source and cytoplasmic DNA from another, such as a nonhuman animal cell that has had its nucleus replaced by the nucleus of a human somatic cell.

label: cumulus-oocyte complex
definition: The cumulus-oocyte complex is an oocyte surrounded by specialized granulosa cells, called cumulus cells.

label: glomus cell
definition: A glomus cell (type I) is a peripheral chemoreceptor, mainly located in the carotid bodies and aortic bodies, that helps the body regulate breathing.

label: aortic body
definition: One of several small structures on the arch of the aorta that contain neural tissue sensitive to the chemical composition of arterial blood. The aortic bodies respond primarily to large reductions in blood oxygen content and trigger an increase in respiratory rate.

label: aortic arch
definition: The aortic arch is the part of the aorta between the ascending and descending aorta.

label: EC-18 cell
definition: Chinese oesophaeal squamous cell carcinoma cell line.

label: vertebra
definition: One of the bony or cartilaginous segments composing the spinal column, consisting in some lower vertebrates of several distinct elements which never become united, and in higher vertebrates having a short more or less cylindrical body whose ends articulate by pads of elastic or cartilaginous tissue with those of adjacent vertebrae and a bony arch that encloses the spinal cord.

label: KYSE-140 cell
definition: Human esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cell line; derived from the moderately differentiated invasive esophageal squamous cell carcinoma resected from middle intra-thoracic esophagus of a 54-year-old Japanese man prior to treatment.

label: 250MK cell
definition: Normal human mammary epithelial cell line.

label: 3D4/21 cell
definition: Sus scrofa lung alveolar macrophage cell line.

label: 76NF2V cell
definition: Human normal mammary epithelial cell line.

label: AML-193 cell
definition: Human acute monocytic leukemia cell line, established from a 13 years old girl.

label: Caki-2 cell
definition: Human kidney clear cell carcinoma cell line, established from a 69-years-old caucasian male.

label: serotonergic neuron
definition: A nerve cell that uses serotonin as its neurotransmitter.

label: extravillous cytotrophoblast
definition: Extravillous cytotrophoblast cells are the cells of the outermost layer of the fetal component of the human placenta. The extravillous cytotrophoblast cells located proximal to the villous stroma are proliferating cells.

label: extravillous cytotrophoblast cell
definition: Extravillous cytotrophoblast cells are the cells of the outermost layer of the fetal component of the human placenta. The extravillous cytotrophoblast cells located proximal to the villous stroma are proliferating cells.

label: extravillous trophoblast cell
definition: The outermost layer of trophoblast, produced by cytotrophoblast where there is direct contact with maternal decidua rather than blood. The EVT cells travel into the decidua, reacting with NK cells and invading maternal blood vessels feeding the placenta, softening the walls and replacing the lining with fetal tissue, a process called conversion.

label: HIPEC-65 cell
definition: The cell line human invasive proliferative extravillous cytotrophoblast 65 expresses markers of human invasive primary cytotrophoblast as determined by immunocytochemistry, immunobloting and real-time RT-PCR, and is highly invasive in vitro.

label: HMT-3522 T4-2 cell
definition: This line is a subline that has been derived from HMT-3522. The parent line was established from a benign breast tumor of a 48 year old woman and has undergone spontaneous malignant transformation.

label: HTC-C3 cell
definition: Human thyroid carcinoma cell line, established from cancer cells disseminated in the pleural fluid of a 44-year-old woman with undifferentiated giant cell carcinoma of the thyroid after chemotherapy, x-ray hyperthermia and OK432 injections in 1986.

label: HTR-8 cell
definition: First trimester human trophoblast cell line. Parental cell line of HTR-8/SVneo.

label: KELLY cell
definition: Human neuroblastoma cell line.

label: KIJ-265T cell
definition: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma cell line, derived from primary tumor site stage 4 human ccRCC patient tissue.

label: KIJ-308T cell
definition: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma cell line.

label: leaf epidermal cell
definition: Any of the cells in a leaf making up the epidermis.

label: chondrogenic MCT cell
definition: Mouse chondrocytes immortalized with a temperature-sensitive simian virus 40 large T antigen.

label: MDA-MB-157 cell
definition: Human breast medulla carcinoma cell line, established from the pleural effusion of a 44 year old woman with metastatic breast cancer.

label: neuromast
definition: One of the characteristic sensory organs of the lateral lines of fishes and various other lower vertebrates consisting of a cluster of sensory cells connected with nerve fibers.

label: UACC-812 cell
definition: Human mammary gland ductal carcinoma cell line, established from breast tissue of a 43 years old female in 1986, removed at mastectomy to remove a ductal carcinoma (stage II, grade IV).

label: U-343MG cell
definition: Human glioblastoma cell line.

label: olfactory placode
definition: A thick plate of cells derived from the neural ectoderm in the head region of the vertebrate embryo and developing into the olfactory region of the nasal cavity.

label: neural ectoderm
definition: The part of the embryonic ectoderm that develops into the neural tube.

label: OP-6 cell
definition: Mouse olfactory placode cell line.

label: olfactory placode cell line
definition: A thick plate of cells derived from the neural ectoderm in the head region of the vertebrate embryo and developing into the olfactory region of the nasal cavity.

label: OP-27 cell
definition: Mouse olfactory placode cell line.

label: RERF-LC-AI cell
definition: Human lung squamous cell carcinoma cell line, established from a japanese male.

label: MDS-92 cell
definition: Human myelodysplastic cell line. Myelodysplastic syndromes are a group of cancers in which immature blood cells in the bone marrow do not mature and therefore do not become healthy blood cells.

label: MDS-L cell
definition: Human myelodysplastic syndrome-derived cell line. Myelodysplastic syndromes are a group of cancers in which immature blood cells in the bone marrow do not mature and therefore do not become healthy blood cells.

label: interfascicular cambium
definition: The vascular cambium of a plant that develops between vascular bundles. A portion of vascular cambium that develops from cells in an interfascicular region that is part of a shoot system.

label: interfascicular region
definition: A portion of ground tissue located between vascular bundles in a shoot axis.

label: PK-15CD163 cell
definition: PK-15 cell line, transfected with porcine CD163 by PiggyBac transposon system.

label: endomysium
definition: Endomysium, meaning within the muscle, is a wispy layer of areolar connective tissue that ensheaths each individual myocyte. It contains capillaries and nerves. It overlies the sarcolemma. Endomysium is the deepest and smallest component of muscle connective tissue.

label: bacteriocyte
definition: A modified fat cell occurring in the fat body of certain insects and containing groups of bacterium-shaped rods that are believed to be symbiotic bacteria.

label: blood-brain barrier
definition: A layer of tightly packed unique endothelial cells that make up the walls of brain capillaries and prevent substances in the blood from diffusing freely into the brain.

label: culture condition:CD11c+ cell
definition: CD11c is an integrin alpha X chain protein found at high levels on most human dendritic cells, but also on monocytes, macrophages, neutrophils, and some B cells that induces cellular activation and helps trigger neutrophil respiratory burst. It is expressed in hairy cell leukemias, acute nonlymphocytic leukemias, and some B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemias.

label: dermatome
definition: The lateral wall of a somite from which the dermis is produced.

label: dorsal endoderm
definition: Single cell layer of involuted endoderm lying beneath the prechordal plate.

label: epibranchial ganglion
definition: Cranial ganglion which develops from an epibranchial placode.

label: UWB1.289 cell
definition: Human ovarian carcinoma cell line; established from a 56-years-old female.

label: UWB1.289+BRCA1 cell
definition: A stable cell line derived from UWB1.289.

label: sclerotome
definition: The lower, medioventral part of the somite, that breaks up into mesenchyme, which contributes to the axial skeleton of the embryo, that is the vertebral column, ribs, and much of the skull.

label: solid cancer cell
definition: An abnormal mass of tissue that usually does not contain cysts or liquid areas. Solid tumors may be benign, or malignant. Different types of solid tumors are named for the type of cells that form them. Examples of solid tumors are sarcomas, carcinomas, and lymphomas. Leukemias  generally do not form solid tumors.

label: oral sucker
definition: A mouth, as of a leech, adapted for sucking or adhering.

label: ventral sucker
definition: A mouth, as of a leech, adapted for sucking or adhering.

label: pluteus
definition: The free-swimming, bilaterally symmetrical larva of an echinoid or ophiuroid.

label: GM02784 cell
definition: Human fibroblast cell line.

label: HL-60/S cell
definition: Promyeloblastic cell line differentiated to neutrophils or macrophages by tumor promoters, vitamine D3 or cytokines.

label: IT-79MTNC3 cell
definition: Mouse thymic tumor cell line.

label: LNCaP-95 cell
definition: An androgen-independent cell line derived from the parental LNCaP cell line.

label: MR49F cell
definition: Enzalutamide-resistant prostate cancer cell line.

label: subfornical organ
definition: A small tubercle in the floor of the third ventricle. The intercolumnar tubercle. One of the circumventricular organs. It has fenestrated capillaries and is outside the blood-brain barrier. It is thought to be a chemoreceptor zone involved in cardiovascular regulation.

label: circumventricular organ
definition: Four small areas in or near the base of the brain that have fenestrated capillaries and are outside the blood-brain barrier. They are the neurohypophysis, the area postrema, the organum vasculosum of the lamina terminalis, and the subfornical organ. The neurohypophysis is a neurohemal organ. The other three are chemoreceptors: the area postrema triggers vomiting in response to chemical changes in plasma, the organum vasculosum of the lamina terminalis senses osmolality and alters vasopressin secretion, and the subfornical organ initiates drinking in response to angiotensin II.

label: organum vasculosum laminae terminalis
definition: One of the four sensory circumventricular organs of the brain.

label: ACI-45 cell
definition: Uterine carcinosarcoma cell line.

label: uterine carcinosarcoma cell line
definition: A malignant tumor cell line combining elements of carcinoma and sarcoma in the uterus.

label: EM-E6E7TERT-1 cell
definition: Immortalized endometrial glandular cells with normal structural and functional characteristics.

label: EM-E6E7TERT-2 cell
definition: Immortalized endometrial glandular cells with normal structural and functional characteristics.

label: EM-E6E7TERT-3 cell
definition: Immortalized endometrial glandular cells with normal structural and functional characteristics.

label: SW-1573/S1 cell
definition: Intrinsic CDDP resistant human non-small-cell lung cancer cell line.

label: outer mantle
definition: Besides pigments, the outer mantle of the giant clam Tridacna squamosa has iridophores which consist of small groups of cells containing stacks of tiny platelets .The reflective platelets scatter light of photosynthetically productive wavelengths into the tissue while back-reflecting non-productive wavelength. Thus, the extensible outer mantle is brightly colored.

label: inner mantle
definition: The inner mantle of the giant clam Tridacna squamosa, adjacent to the extrapallial fluid, as demarcated by the pallial line of the shell-valve, is thin and whitish, and is involved in shell formation.

label: tubulointerstitium
definition: The tubules and interstitial tissue of the kidneys.

label: vas deferens ampulla
definition: The end of each vas deferens has an expanded portion, the ampulla, that serves as a reservoir for sperm.

label: YY-8103 cell
definition: Human hepatocellular carcinoma cell line.

label: TIG-3 cell
definition: Human embryonic lung fibroblast cell line.

label: SPC-A4 cell
definition: Human lung adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: disc floret
definition: Any of the small tubular flowers at the centre of the flower head of certain composite plants, such as the daisy.

label: MGH-U3 cell
definition: MGH-U3 and -U4, derived respectively from a grade 1 tumor and an urothelium biopsy with severe atypia, are likely to be independent human bladder cell lines and different from other transitional cell bladder carcinoma cell lines reported.

label: MGH-U4 cell
definition: MGH-U3 and -U4, derived respectively from a grade 1 tumor and an urothelium biopsy with severe atypia, are likely to be independent human bladder cell lines and different from other transitional cell bladder carcinoma cell lines reported.

label: Vero 2.2 cell
definition: A derivative of Vero cells.

label: UM-UC-2 cell
definition: Human urinary bladder transitional cell carcinoma cell line, but shown to be a derivative of T-24.

label: Mbeta16tsA cell
definition: Wild-type mouse embryonic fibroblast cell line Mbeta16tsA.

label: Aag-2 cell
definition: Aedes aegypti derived clonal mosquito cell line; derived from a neonate mosquito embryo.

label: BWZ.36 cell
definition: Mouse lymphoma cell line, derived by transfecting alpha-beta-BW5147 cells with the NFAT-lacZ construct.

label: BWZ.36 CD8 alpha cell
definition: Mouse lymphoma cell line, derived by transfecting alpha-beta-BW5147 cells with the NFAT-lacZ construct.

label: celiac ganglion
definition: Either of a pair of collateral sympathetic ganglia that are the largest of the autonomic nervous system and lie one on each side of the celiac artery near the adrenal gland on the same side.

label: CH12F3 cell
definition: Mouse B-lymphocyte cell line.

label: HepAD38 cell
definition: HepAD38 is a stably transfected hepatoblastoma cell line that replicates human HBV under the control of a tetracycline-regulated promoter.

label: gastric cecum
definition: One of the elongated pouches projecting from the upper end of the insect stomach.

label: hemolysate
definition: Preparation resulting from the lysis of erythrocytes.

label: HepG2-N10 cell
definition: This cell line was constructed by stable transfection of a 1.3 fold adw subtype HBV genome into HepG2 cells.

label: mpkCCD cell
definition: Mouse cortical collecting duct cell line.

label: Mull cell
definition: Human melanoma cell line.

label: JC cell
definition: Mouse mammary gland adenocarcinoma cell line.

label: rhizodermis
definition: The outermost primary cell layer of the root.

label: stichosome
definition: A column of glandular cells associated with the esophagus of various nematodes.

label: SW-780 cell
definition: Urinary bladder transitional cell carcinoma cell line; established in 1974 from a grade I transitional cell carcinoma.

label: TCC-SUP cell
definition: Urinary bladder transitional cell carcinoma cell line; established from the tumor spediment resected from the undifferentiated grade IV urinary bladder transitional cell carcinoma of a 67-year-old woman in 1974.

label: WIF-B9 cell
definition: Rat hepatoma/human fibroblast hybrid cell line.

label: WIF-B9/R cell
definition: Subline of WIF-B9 cell line, obtained by exposure to progressively increasing cisplatin concentrations and double sub-clonal selection.

label: WI38-VA13 cell
definition: Normal human lung fibroblast cell line.

label: plantaris muscle
definition: A small muscle of the calf of the leg that arises from the lower end of the femur and the posterior ligament of the knee joint, is inserted with the Achilles tendon by a very long slender tendon into the calcaneus, and weakly felxes the leg at the knee and the foot at the ankle.

label: taproot
definition: Main root of a primary root system, growing vertically downward. Most dicotyledonous plants, such as dandelions, produce taproots, and some, such as the edible roots of carrots and beets, are specialized for food storage.

label: shell capitulum
definition: Pedunculate, goose or goose-neck barnacles have a flexible, muscular stalk, known as the peduncle, which supports the main body known as the capitulum. In Pollicipes pollicipes the capitulum is triangular in nature and white-grey in colour. A number of plates of different sizes protect the capitulum, increasing to over 100 in number with age. The plates may reach up to 0.5 mm in length. Six pairs of thin, feather-like cirri can be seen to arise from within the mantle cavity and are used for feeding.

label: shell peduncle
definition: Pedunculate, goose or goose-neck barnacles have a flexible, muscular stalk, known as the peduncle, which supports the main body known as the capitulum. In Pollicipes pollicipes the peduncle may reach over 10 cm in length and is strongly attached to the substratum despite repeated battering in exposed conditions.

label: compound leaf
definition: A leaf in which the blade is divided to the midrib, forming two or more distinct blades or leaflets on a common axis, the leaflets themselves occasionally being compound.

label: plant rachis
definition: The main axis or stem of an inflorescence or compound leaf.

definition: Is a substrate for basidiomycetes.

BLC's are thinly extended over bone surfaces, have flat or slightly ovoid nuclei, connect to other BLC's via gap junctions, and send cell processes into surface canaliculi. BLC's can be induced to proliferate and differentiate into osteogenic cells and may represent a source of "determined" osteogenic precursors. BLC's and other cells of the endosteal tissues may be an integral part of the marrow stromal system and have important functions in hematopoiesis, perhaps by controlling the inductive microenvironment.

definition: The lateral hypothalamus contains the primary orexinergic nucleus within the hypothalamus that widely projects throughout the nervous system. label: Edinger-Westphal nucleus
definition: The parasympathetic pre-ganglionic nucleus that innervates the iris sphincter muscle and the ciliary muscle. definition: The human sarcoma cell line HT 1080 was transfected with a vector encoding a selectable marker (guanine phosphoribosyltransferase) regulated by alpha interferon to create the 2fTGH cell line, enabling the selection of mutations in genes encoding components of the interferon signalling pathway. Chemical mutagenesis of the parent 2fTGH cell line enabled the isolation of a number of IFNg signalling mutants available from ECACC: U2A , U3A , U4A, U4C, U5A, U6A. label: hedge

label: hill range

label: sea beach

label: lacustrine beach

label: stream valley

label: permafrost
definition: An environmental material which is 1) composed primarily of soil or rock and included ice or organic material and 2) at or below the freezing point of water for two or more years.

label: buffer zone
definition: A geographical region that serves the purpose of keeping two or more other areas (often, but not necessarily, countries) distant from one another, for whatever reason.

label: demilitarized zone
definition: A geographical area, usually the frontier or boundary between two or more military powers (or alliances), where military activity is not permitted, usually by peace treaty, armistice or other bilateral or multilateral agreement.

definition: An opening of the sea into the land.

definition: The sloping margin of a river, serving to confine it to its natural channel.

label: ice cap
definition: A dome-shaped ice mass that covers less than 50,000 km2 of land area (usually covering a highland area).

label: snow field
definition: A region of permanent snow in mountainous areas or high latitudes.

label: ocean current
definition: The region occupied by any more or less continuous, directed movement of ocean water that flows in one of the Earth's oceans. Ocean Currents are rivers of hot or cold water within the ocean. The currents are generated from the forces acting upon the water like the earth's rotation, the wind, the temperature and salinity differences and the gravitation of the moon. The depth contours, the shoreline and other movements influence the direction and strength of the movements of water that forms a given current.

label: riffle
definition: A shallow stretch of a river or stream, where the current is above the average stream velocity and where the water forms small rippled waves as a result. It often consists of a rocky bed of gravels or other small stones.

label: artificial reef
definition: Chains of rocks or coral at or near the surface of water constructed by man.

label: coral reef
definition: A marine reef which is composed primarily of aragonite structures produced by living organisms, found in shallow, low-nutrient waters.

label: sabkha
definition: An alkaline flat, in the context of a marine environment.

label: anabranch
definition: A section of a river or stream that diverts from the main course and rejoins later.

label: headwater
definition: The upper part of a river system, denoting the upper basin and source streams of a river.

label: flood meadow ecosystem
definition: An area of grassland or pasture beside a river, subject to seasonal flooding.

label: cirque
definition: A depression which is semicircular or crescent-shaped, found towards the crest of a mountain, and formed by the erosional processes caused by the motion of a glacier.

label: desert oasis
definition: A small, isolated, fertile or green area in a desert region, usually having a spring or well.

label: peat cut
definition: An artificial working of peatland to remove the peat.

label: causeway
definition: A road or railway elevated by a bank, usually across a broad body of water or wetland.

label: rubber plantation
definition: A plantation which is used to grow Hevea brasiliensis or other species from which natural latex is harvested.

label: asphalt lake
definition: A lake formed of a natural deposit of alphalt, a black, highly viscous liquid or semi-solid composed of fossil hydrocarbons.

label: atoll
definition: An oceanic island, often having a characteristic ring-like shape surrounding a lagoon. Atolls are formed when coral reef grows around a volcanic island that later subsides into the ocean.

label: bar
definition: A linear shoaling landform feature within a body of water. Bars tend to be long and narrow (linear) and develop where a current (or waves) promote deposition of granular material, resulting in localized shallowing (shoaling) of the water. Bars can appear in the sea, in a lake, or in a river. They are typically composed of sand, although could be of any granular matter that the moving water has access to and is capable of shifting around (for example, soil, silt, gravel, cobble, shingle, or even boulders). The grain size of the material comprising a bar is related: to the size of the waves or the strength of the currents moving the material, but the availability of material to be worked by waves and currents is also important.

definition: A hole in coastal rock through which sea water is forced by a rising tide or waves and spurted through an outlet into the air.

label: canyon
definition: Relatively narrow, deep depression with steep sides, the bottom of which generally has a continuous slope.

label: dune
definition: A hill of sand built by eolian processes.

label: river valley
definition: A valley that contains, and has been formed by, a river.

label: sandy desert
definition: A desert plain characterized by a surface veneer of sand.

label: rocky desert
definition: A desert plain characterized by a surface veneer of rock.

label: isthmus
definition: Narrow section of land in a body of water connecting two larger land areas.

label: karst
definition: A surface landform which is formed by the dissolution of a soluble layer or layers of bedrock.

label: elevated landform
definition: A landform elevated above the surrounding area.

label: moraine
definition: An accumulation of boulders, stones, or other debris carried and deposited by a glacier.

label: levee
definition: An artificial slope or wall, usually earthen, which parallels the course of a river, built for the purpose of containing the river.

label: mesa
definition: An elevated area of land with a flat top and sides that are usually steep cliffs. Mesas form in areas where horizontally layered rocks are uplifted by tectonic activity.

label: mound
definition: A rounded elevated area.

label: nunatak
definition: The exposed summit of a ridge, mountain, or peak not covered with ice or snow within an ice field or glacier. The term is typically used in areas where a permanent ice mass is present.

label: plateau
definition: An elevated and comparatively level expanse of land.

label: stony desert
definition: A desert plain characterized by a surface veneer of gravel or stones.

label: hanging valley
definition: A tributary valley with the floor at a higher relief than the main channel into which it flows. They are most commonly associated with U-shaped valleys when a tributary glacier flows into a glacier of larger volume.

label: raised mire
definition: Rain-fed, potentially deep peatlands occurring principally in lowland areas across much of Northern Europe, as well as in the former USSR, North America and parts of the southern hemisphere.

label: string mire
definition: Flat or concave peatlands with a string-like pattern of hummocks (hence the name), found principally in northern Scandinavia but occurring in the western parts of the former USSR and in North America. A few examples exist in northern Britain.

label: tundra mire
definition: Peatlands with a shallow peat layer, only about 500 mm thick, dominated by sedges and grasses. They form in permafrost areas, covering around 110,000 to 160,000 km2 in Alaska, Canada, and the former USSR.

label: palsa mire
definition: Peatland typified by characteristic high mounds, each with a permanently frozen core, with wet depressions between the mounds.

label: peat swamp
definition: Forested peatlands including both rain- and groundwater-fed types, commonly recorded in tropical regions with high rainfall.

label: abyssal feature
definition: Feature on the ocean floor at a depth of 3500 - 6000 meters.

label: solid astronomical body part
definition: A part of an astronomical body which is primarily composed of solid material.

label: mudflat
definition: A wetland that forms when mud is deposited by the tides, rivers, sea or oceans.

label: scree
definition: Broken rock that appears at the bottom of crags, mountain cliffs or valley shoulders.

label: sinkhole
definition: A natural depression or hole in the surface topography caused by the removal of soil or bedrock, often both, by water. Sinkholes may vary in size from less than a meter to several hundred meters both in diameter and depth, and vary in form from soil-lined bowls to bedrock-edged chasms.

label: alkaline flat
definition: A dry lakebed consisting of fine-grained sediments infused with alkali salts. Generally the shore or bed of an endorheic lake.

label: endorheic lake
definition: A lake from which there is no outflow of water, either on the surface as rivers, or underground by flow or diffusion through rock or permeable material.

label: ice-covered lake
definition: A lake permanently covered by ice.

label: meromictic lake
definition: A lake which has layers of water which do not intermix.

label: periglacial lake
definition: A lake, part of whose margin is formed by an ice mass, ice cap or glacier, the ice having obstructed the natural drainage of the land.

label: fjord lake
definition: A lake in a glacially eroded valley, which has been eroded below sea level.

label: oxbow lake
definition: A lake which is formed when a wide meander from a stream or a river is cut off to form a lake. They are called oxbow lakes due to the distinctive curved shape that results from this process.

label: rift lake
definition: A lake which fills a depression that has formed as a result of subsidence along a a rift zone, an area of extensional tectonics in the continental crust.

label: ephemeral spring
definition: A spring through which fluid intermittently flows.

label: permanent spring
definition: A spring whose flow is continuous.

label: marine neritic zone
definition: The water mass of an ocean directly above a continental shelf.

label: oceanic zone
definition: The water mass of an ocean that is not above a continental shelf.
